lines.speaker: A
lines.text: Could you make the espresso a little shorter than usual?
lines.ipa: /kʊd juː mˌeɪk ðɪ ɛspɹˈɛsəʊ ɐ lˈɪtəl ʃˈɔːtə ðɐn jˈuːʒuːəl/

lines.speaker: B
lines.text: Certainly. You're after something more concentrated, rather than a smaller dose?
lines.ipa: /sˈɜːtənli jɔːɹ ˈaftə sˈʌmθɪŋ mˈɔː kˈɒnsəntɹˌeɪtɪd ɹˈɑːðə ðˌanə smˈɔːlə dˈəʊs/

lines.speaker: A
lines.text: Exactly. People sometimes hear small and give me less coffee altogether.
lines.ipa: /ɛɡzˈaktli pˈiːpəl sˈʌmtaɪmz hˈiə smˈɔːl and ɡˈɪv mˌiː lˈɛs kˈɒfi ˌɔːltəɡˈɛðə/

lines.speaker: B
lines.text: Thanks for spelling that out. I'll stop the extraction earlier.
lines.ipa: /θˈaŋks fɔː spˈɛlɪŋ ðat ˈaʊt aɪl stˈɒp ðɪ ɛkstɹˈakʃən ˈɜːlɪə/

lines.speaker: A
lines.text: I was going to order the expensive tea until you described it as delicate.
lines.ipa: /aɪ wɒz ɡˌəʊɪŋ tʊ ˈɔːdə ðɪ ɛkspˈɛnsɪv tˈiː ʌntˈɪl juː dɪskɹˈaɪbd ɪt az dˈɛlɪkət/

lines.speaker: B
lines.text: Is that not what you usually enjoy?
lines.ipa: /ɪz ðat nˌɒt wɒt juː jˈuːʒuːəli ɛndʒˈɔɪ/

lines.speaker: A
lines.text: Delicate sometimes turns out to mean I can barely taste it.
lines.ipa: /dˈɛlɪkət sˈʌmtaɪmz tˈɜːnz ˈaʊt tə mˈiːn aɪ kan bˈeəli tˈeɪst ɪt/

lines.speaker: B
lines.text: Then the breakfast blend is probably a better fit, regardless of the price.
lines.ipa: /ðˈɛn ðə bɹˈɛkfəst blˈɛnd ɪz pɹˈɒbəbli ɐ bˈɛtə fˈɪt ɹɪɡˈɑːdləs ɒvðə pɹˈaɪs/

lines.speaker: A
lines.text: You've remembered the oat milk. I'm impressed.
lines.ipa: /juːv ɹɪmˈɛmbəd ðɪ ˈəʊt mˈɪlk aɪm ɪmpɹˈɛst/

lines.speaker: B
lines.text: You mentioned it yesterday, and you ordered at roughly the same time.
lines.ipa: /juː mˈɛnʃənd ɪt jˈɛstədˌeɪ and juː ˈɔːdəd at ɹˈʌfli ðə sˈeɪm tˈaɪm/

lines.speaker: A
lines.text: I must be more predictable than I thought.
lines.ipa: /aɪ mˈʌst biː mˈɔː pɹɪdˈɪktəbəl ðɐn aɪ θˈɔːt/

lines.speaker: B
lines.text: Only about breakfast. I wouldn't claim to know your entire personality from a coffee.
lines.ipa: /ˈəʊnli ɐbˌaʊt bɹˈɛkfəst aɪ wˈʊdənt klˈeɪm tə nˈəʊ jɔːɹ ɛntˈaɪə pˌɜːsənˈalɪti fɹɒm ɐ kˈɒfi/

lines.speaker: A
lines.text: I thought bringing my own cup would make ordering simpler.
lines.ipa: /aɪ θˈɔːt bɹˈɪŋɪŋ maɪ ˈəʊn kˈʌp wʊd mˌeɪk ˈɔːdəɹɪŋ sˈɪmplə/

lines.speaker: B
lines.text: Has someone asked you to buy a disposable one first?
lines.ipa: /hɐz sˈʌmwɒn ˈaskt juː tə bˈaɪ ɐ dɪspˈəʊzəbəl wˈɒn fˈɜːst/

lines.speaker: A
lines.text: They said the discount only works if they scan the code on a paper cup.
lines.ipa: /ðeɪ sˈɛd ðə dˈɪskaʊnt ˈəʊnli wˈɜːks ɪf ðeɪ skˈan ðə kˈəʊd ˌɒn ɐ pˈeɪpə kˈʌp/

lines.speaker: B
lines.text: That defeats the point. I'll apply it manually and flag the problem.
lines.ipa: /ðat dɪfˈiːts ðə pˈɔɪnt aɪl ɐplˈaɪ ɪt mˈanjuːəli and flˈaɡ ðə pɹˈɒbləm/

lines.speaker: A
lines.text: We want the cake divided equally, though my brother will inspect the portions.
lines.ipa: /wiː wˈɒnt ðə kˈeɪk dɪvˈaɪdɪd ˈiːkwəli ðˌəʊ maɪ bɹˈʌðə wɪl ɪnspˈɛkt ðə pˈɔːʃənz/

lines.speaker: B
lines.text: Shall I weigh them and put an end to the negotiations?
lines.ipa: /ʃˌal aɪ wˈeɪ ðˌɛm and pˌʊt ɐn ˈɛnd tə ðə nɪɡˌəʊʃɪˈeɪʃənz/

lines.speaker: A
lines.text: You joke, but that might save Christmas.
lines.ipa: /juː dʒˈəʊk bˌʌt ðat mˌaɪt sˈeɪv kɹˈɪsməs/

lines.speaker: B
lines.text: I'll leave the scales where he can see them.
lines.ipa: /aɪl lˈiːv ðə skˈeɪlz wˌeə hiː kan sˈiː ðˌɛm/

lines.speaker: A
lines.text: I asked for less ice, but this glass is almost entirely milk.
lines.ipa: /aɪ ˈaskt fɔː lˈɛs ˈaɪs bˌʌt ðɪs ɡlˈas ɪz ˈɔːlməʊst ɛntˈaɪəli mˈɪlk/

lines.speaker: B
lines.text: The proportions should have stayed the same. Less ice isn't a request for a different drink.
lines.ipa: /ðə pɹəpˈɔːʃənz ʃˌʊdəv stˈeɪd ðə sˈeɪm lˈɛs ˈaɪs ˌɪzənt ɐ ɹɪkwˈɛst fəɹə dˈɪfɹənt dɹˈɪŋk/

lines.speaker: A
lines.text: I was starting to wonder whether I'd explained myself badly.
lines.ipa: /aɪ wɒz stˈɑːtɪŋ tə wˈʌndə wˈɛðəɹ aɪd ɛksplˈeɪnd maɪsˈɛlf bˈadli/

lines.speaker: B
lines.text: You hadn't. Let me replace it with the balance you expected.
lines.ipa: /juː hˈadənt lˈɛt mˌiː ɹɪplˈeɪs ɪt wɪððə bˈaləns juː ɛkspˈɛktɪd/

lines.speaker: A
lines.text: Are the books on this table there for customers to read?
lines.ipa: /ɑː ðə bˈʊks ˌɒn ðɪs tˈeɪbəl ðeə fɔː kˈʌstəməz tə ɹˈiːd/

lines.speaker: B
lines.text: Yes, though the annotations are left by people who've sat here before.
lines.ipa: /jˈɛs ðˌəʊ ðɪ ˌanətˈeɪʃənz ɑː lˈɛft baɪ pˈiːpəl hˌuːəv sˈat hˈiə bɪfˈɔː/

lines.speaker: A
lines.text: I thought someone had forgotten a very opinionated copy of the novel.
lines.ipa: /aɪ θˈɔːt sˈʌmwɒn had fəɡˈɒtən ɐ vˈɛɹi əpˈɪniənˌeɪtɪd kˈɒpɪ ɒvðə nˈɒvəl/

lines.speaker: B
lines.text: That's more or less how the shelf began. You're welcome to add a note.
lines.ipa: /ðats mˈɔː ɔː lˈɛs hˌaʊ ðə ʃˈɛlf bɪɡˈan jɔː wˈɛlkʌm tʊ ˈad ɐ nˈəʊt/

lines.speaker: A
lines.text: I offered to pay before noticing everyone had ordered lunch as well.
lines.ipa: /aɪ ˈɒfəd tə pˈeɪ bɪfˌɔː nˈəʊtɪsɪŋ ˈɛvɹɪwˌɒn had ˈɔːdəd lˈʌntʃ az wˈɛl/

lines.speaker: B
lines.text: You can still say you meant the coffees.
lines.ipa: /juː kan stˈɪl sˈeɪ juː mˈɛnt ðə kˈɒfiz/

lines.speaker: A
lines.text: It would sound as though I'd suddenly become very precise about my generosity.
lines.ipa: /ɪt wʊd sˈaʊnd az ðˌəʊ aɪd sˈʌdənli bɪkˌʌm vˈɛɹi pɹɪsˈaɪs ɐbˌaʊt maɪ dʒˌɛnəɹˈɒsɪti/

lines.speaker: B
lines.text: Then let me cover the food. We'll both escape gracefully.
lines.ipa: /ðˈɛn lˈɛt mˌiː kˈʌvə ðə fˈuːd wiːl bˈəʊθ ɛskˈeɪp ɡɹˈeɪsfəli/

lines.speaker: A
lines.text: Our poetry group needs a room where nobody feels obliged to perform.
lines.ipa: /ˌaʊə pˈəʊɪtɹi ɡɹˈuːp nˈiːdz ɐ ɹˈuːm wˌeə nˈəʊbɒdi fˈiːlz əblˈaɪdʒd tə pəfˈɔːm/

lines.speaker: B
lines.text: Would a separate room make newcomers more comfortable or more conspicuous?
lines.ipa: /wʊd ɐ sˈɛpɹət ɹˈuːm mˌeɪk njˈuːkʌməz mˈɔː kˈʌmftəbəl ɔː mˈɔː kənspˈɪkjuːəs/

lines.speaker: A
lines.text: Good question. A corner of the cafe might feel less like a stage.
lines.ipa: /ɡˈʊd kwˈɛstʃən ɐ kˈɔːnəɹ ɒvðə kˈafeɪ mˌaɪt fˈiːl lˈɛs lˈaɪk ɐ stˈeɪdʒ/

lines.speaker: B
lines.text: We can try that once before you commit to a regular booking.
lines.ipa: /wiː kan tɹˈaɪ ðat wˈʌns bɪfˌɔː juː kəmˈɪt tʊ ɐ ɹˈɛɡjʊlə bˈʊkɪŋ/

lines.speaker: A
lines.text: I wanted to thank the member of staff who noticed I'd left my bag.
lines.ipa: /aɪ wˈɒntɪd tə θˈaŋk ðə mˈɛmbəɹ ɒv stˈaf hˌuː nˈəʊtɪst aɪd lˈɛft maɪ bˈaɡ/

lines.speaker: B
lines.text: Do you remember when you were here?
lines.ipa: /dˈuː juː ɹɪmˈɛmbə wɛn juː wɜː hˈiə/

lines.speaker: A
lines.text: Late yesterday. She didn't just keep it safe; she found the number on my luggage tag.
lines.ipa: /lˈeɪt jˈɛstədˌeɪ ʃiː dˈɪdnt dʒˈʌst kˈiːp ɪt sˈeɪf ʃiː fˈaʊnd ðə nˈʌmbəɹ ˌɒn maɪ lˈʌɡɪdʒ tˈaɡ/

lines.speaker: B
lines.text: I'll make sure she hears that. The useful details often disappear from general praise.
lines.ipa: /aɪl mˌeɪk ʃˈʊə ʃiː hˈiəz ðˈat ðə jˈuːsfəl dˈiːteɪlz ˈɒfən dˌɪsɐpˈiə fɹɒm dʒˈɛnəɹəl pɹˈeɪz/

lines.speaker: A
lines.text: The rail pass looks good value, but only if I travel constantly.
lines.ipa: /ðə ɹˈeɪl pˈas lˈʊks ɡˈʊd vˈaljuː bˌʌt ˈəʊnli ɪf aɪ tɹˈavəl kˈɒnstəntli/

lines.speaker: B
lines.text: Are you trying to save money or give yourself permission to make the trip?
lines.ipa: /ɑː juː tɹˈaɪɪŋ tə sˈeɪv mˈʌni ɔː ɡˈɪv jɔːsˈɛlf pəmˈɪʃən tə mˌeɪk ðə tɹˈɪp/

lines.speaker: A
lines.text: A bit of both, though the spreadsheet is pretending it's purely financial.
lines.ipa: /ɐ bˈɪt ɒv bˈəʊθ ðˌəʊ ðə spɹˈɛdʃiːt ɪz pɹɪtˈɛndɪŋ ɪts pjˈʊəli faɪnˈanʃəl/

lines.speaker: B
lines.text: Price the journey you'd actually enjoy, not the one that makes the pass look clever.
lines.ipa: /pɹˈaɪs ðə dʒˈɜːni juːd ˈaktʃuːəli ɛndʒˈɔɪ nˌɒt ðə wˈɒn ðat mˌeɪks ðə pˈas lˈʊk klˈɛvə/

lines.speaker: A
lines.text: The replacement bus stop is easy to find once you've found it.
lines.ipa: /ðə ɹɪplˈeɪsmənt bˈʌs stˈɒp ɪz ˈiːzi tə fˈaɪnd wˈʌns juːv fˈaʊnd ɪt/

lines.speaker: B
lines.text: Which is another way of saying the signs aren't doing their job.
lines.ipa: /wˌɪtʃ ɪz ɐnˈʌðə wˈeɪ ɒv sˈeɪɪŋ ðə sˈaɪnz ˌɑːnt dˌuːɪŋ ðeə dʒˈɒb/

lines.speaker: A
lines.text: Exactly. The final sign is excellent; the missing first one is the problem.
lines.ipa: /ɛɡzˈaktli ðə fˈaɪnəl sˈaɪn ɪz ˈɛksələnt ðə mˈɪsɪŋ fˈɜːst wˈɒn ɪz ðə pɹˈɒbləm/

lines.speaker: B
lines.text: I'll report the gap in the route, not ask for a larger sign at the destination.
lines.ipa: /aɪl ɹɪpˈɔːt ðə ɡˈap ɪnðə ɹˈuːt nˌɒt ˈask fəɹə lˈɑːdʒə sˈaɪn at ðə dˌɛstɪnˈeɪʃən/

lines.speaker: A
lines.text: We've made every connection so far, but I'm no longer enjoying the holiday.
lines.ipa: /wiːv mˌeɪd ˈɛvɹɪ kənˈɛkʃən sˈəʊ fˌɑː bˌʌt aɪm nˌəʊ lˈɒŋɡəɹ ɛndʒˈɔɪɪŋ ðə hˈɒlɪdˌeɪ/

lines.speaker: B
lines.text: The itinerary leaves no room for anything to go slightly wrong.
lines.ipa: /ðɪ aɪtˈɪnəɹəɹi lˈiːvz nˈəʊ ɹˈuːm fɔːɹ ˈɛnɪθˌɪŋ tə ɡˌəʊ slˈaɪtli ɹˈɒŋ/

lines.speaker: A
lines.text: Or unexpectedly right. We walked past a festival to catch the next train.
lines.ipa: /ɔːɹ ˌʌnɛkspˈɛktɪdli ɹˈaɪt wiː wˈɔːkt pˈast ɐ fˈɛstɪvəl tə kˈatʃ ðə nˈɛkst tɹˈeɪn/

lines.speaker: B
lines.text: Let's sacrifice one booking and recover the afternoon.
lines.ipa: /lˈɛts sˈakɹɪfˌaɪs wˈɒn bˈʊkɪŋ and ɹɪkˈʌvə ðɪ ˌaftənˈuːn/

lines.speaker: A
lines.text: The airline found my suitcase, but it's following an itinerary of its own.
lines.ipa: /ðɪ ˈeəlaɪn fˈaʊnd maɪ sˈuːtkeɪs bˌʌt ɪts fˈɒləʊɪŋ ɐn aɪtˈɪnəɹəɹi ɒv ɪts ˈəʊn/

lines.speaker: B
lines.text: Where is it now?
lines.ipa: /wˌeəɹ ɪz ɪt nˈaʊ/

lines.speaker: A
lines.text: Two cities behind me, apparently enjoying a slower holiday.
lines.ipa: /tˈuː sˈɪtiz bɪhˈaɪnd mˌiː ɐpˈaɹəntli ɛndʒˈɔɪɪŋ ɐ slˈəʊə hˈɒlɪdˌeɪ/

lines.speaker: B
lines.text: Give them the address you'll actually be at tomorrow, not tonight's hotel.
lines.ipa: /ɡˈɪv ðˌɛm ðɪ ɐdɹˈɛs juːl ˈaktʃuːəli biː at təmˈɒɹəʊ nˌɒt tənˈaɪts həʊtˈɛl/

lines.speaker: A
lines.text: The delay announcement was technically informative and practically useless.
lines.ipa: /ðə dɪlˈeɪ ɐnˈaʊnsmənt wɒz tˈɛknɪkli ɪnfˈɔːmətˌɪv and pɹˈaktɪkli jˈuːsləs/

lines.speaker: B
lines.text: You mean the phrase operational circumstances?
lines.ipa: /juː mˈiːn ðə fɹˈeɪz ˌɒpəɹˈeɪʃənəl sˈɜːkəmstˌansɪz/

lines.speaker: A
lines.text: Yes. It tells us there is a reason without helping us decide whether to wait.
lines.ipa: /jˈɛs ɪt tˈɛlz ˌʌs ðeəɹ ɪz ɐ ɹˈiːzən wɪðˌaʊt hˈɛlpɪŋ ˌʌs dɪsˈaɪd wˈɛðə tə wˈeɪt/

lines.speaker: B
lines.text: Let's ask for the next decision time rather than a prediction they can't support.
lines.ipa: /lˈɛts ˈask fəðə nˈɛkst dɪsˈɪʒən tˈaɪm ɹˈɑːðə ðˌanə pɹɪdˈɪkʃən ðeɪ kˈɑːnt səpˈɔːt/

lines.speaker: A
lines.text: The bike-hire app congratulated me on completing the journey, but wouldn't lock the bike.
lines.ipa: /ðə bˈaɪkhˈaɪəɹ ˈap kəŋɡɹˈatʃʊlˌeɪtɪd mˌiː ˌɒn kəmplˈiːtɪŋ ðə dʒˈɜːni bˌʌt wˈʊdənt lˈɒk ðə bˈaɪk/

lines.speaker: B
lines.text: Did the ride end before the lock registered?
lines.ipa: /dˈɪd ðə ɹˈaɪd ˈɛnd bɪfˌɔː ðə lˈɒk ɹˈɛdʒɪstəd/

lines.speaker: A
lines.text: Apparently. Now I'm being asked to rate a service I'm still trying to finish.
lines.ipa: /ɐpˈaɹəntli nˈaʊ aɪm bˌiːɪŋ ˈaskt tə ɹˈeɪt ɐ sˈɜːvɪs aɪm stˈɪl tɹˈaɪɪŋ tə fˈɪnɪʃ/

lines.speaker: B
lines.text: Photograph the bike's location and ask support to confirm the handover.
lines.ipa: /fˈəʊtəɡɹˌaf ðə bˈaɪkz ləʊkˈeɪʃən and ˈask səpˈɔːt tə kənfˈɜːm ðə hˈandəʊvə/

lines.speaker: A
lines.text: The assistance team was excellent once we reached the platform.
lines.ipa: /ðɪ ɐsˈɪstəns tˈiːm wɒz ˈɛksələnt wˈʌns wiː ɹˈiːtʃt ðə plˈatfɔːm/

lines.speaker: B
lines.text: But getting to them was the difficult part?
lines.ipa: /bˌʌt ɡˌɛtɪŋ tə ðˌɛm wʌzðə dˈɪfɪkəlt pˈɑːt/

lines.speaker: A
lines.text: The meeting point was beyond the barrier we needed help to cross.
lines.ipa: /ðə mˈiːtɪŋ pˈɔɪnt wɒz bɪjˌɒnd ðə bˈaɹiə wiː nˈiːdɪd hˈɛlp tə kɹˈɒs/

lines.speaker: B
lines.text: That's a small planning error with rather large consequences.
lines.ipa: /ðats ɐ smˈɔːl plˈanɪŋ ˈɛɹə wɪð ɹˈɑːðə lˈɑːdʒ kˈɒnsɪkwənsɪz/

lines.speaker: A
lines.text: I don't mind sharing a taxi, but I hadn't agreed to a sightseeing tour.
lines.ipa: /aɪ dˈəʊnt mˈaɪnd ʃˈeəɹɪŋ ɐ tˈaksi bˌʌt aɪ hˈadənt ɐɡɹˈiːd tʊ ɐ sˈaɪtsiːɪŋ tˈʊə/

lines.speaker: B
lines.text: Was the detour for another passenger's address?
lines.ipa: /wʌzðə dˈiːtʊə fɔːɹ ɐnˈʌðə pˈasɪndʒəz ɐdɹˈɛs/

lines.speaker: A
lines.text: Three addresses, none mentioned when we booked.
lines.ipa: /θɹˈiː ɐdɹˈɛsɪz nˈɒn mˈɛnʃənd wɛn wiː bˈʊkt/

lines.speaker: B
lines.text: Then the service sold as shared wasn't quite the service you knowingly accepted.
lines.ipa: /ðˈɛn ðə sˈɜːvɪs sˈəʊld az ʃˈeəd wˌɒzn̩t kwˈaɪt ðə sˈɜːvɪs juː nˈəʊɪŋli ɐksˈɛptɪd/

lines.speaker: A
lines.text: The refund arrived with no explanation of how the amount was calculated.
lines.ipa: /ðə ɹˈiːfʌnd ɐɹˈaɪvd wɪð nˈəʊ ɛksplɐnˈeɪʃən ɒv hˌaʊ ðɪ ɐmˈaʊnt wɒz kˈalkjʊlˌeɪtɪd/

lines.speaker: B
lines.text: Is it less than you expected?
lines.ipa: /ɪz ɪt lˈɛs ðɐn juː ɛkspˈɛktɪd/

lines.speaker: A
lines.text: Enough to question, not enough to justify another week of chasing.
lines.ipa: /ɪnˈʌf tə kwˈɛstʃən nˌɒt ɪnˈʌf tə dʒˈʌstɪfˌaɪ ɐnˈʌðə wˈiːk ɒv tʃˈeɪsɪŋ/

lines.speaker: B
lines.text: Ask for the breakdown first. You shouldn't have to reverse-engineer their answer.
lines.ipa: /ˈask fəðə bɹˈeɪkdaʊn fˈɜːst juː ʃˈʊdəntavtə ɹɪvˈɜːsˌɛndʒɪnˈiə ðeəɹ ˈansə/

lines.speaker: A
lines.text: The overnight train isn't the fastest option, but it gives us a day back.
lines.ipa: /ðɪ ˌəʊvənˈaɪt tɹˈeɪn ˌɪzənt ðə fˈastɪst ˈɒpʃən bˌʌt ɪt ɡˈɪvz ˌʌs ɐ dˈeɪ bˈak/

lines.speaker: B
lines.text: Provided you can sleep on it.
lines.ipa: /pɹəvˈaɪdɪd juː kan slˈiːp ˈɒn ɪt/

lines.speaker: A
lines.text: That's the part the travel comparison doesn't measure.
lines.ipa: /ðats ðə pˈɑːt ðə tɹˈavəl kəmpˈaɹɪsən dˈʌzənt mˈɛʒə/

lines.speaker: B
lines.text: Then let's read about the actual sleeping arrangement before congratulating ourselves.
lines.ipa: /ðˈɛn lˈɛts ɹˈiːd ɐbˌaʊt ðɪ ˈaktʃuːəl slˈiːpɪŋ ɐɹˈeɪndʒmənt bɪfˌɔː kəŋɡɹˈatʃʊlˌeɪtɪŋ aʊəsˈɛlvz/

lines.speaker: A
lines.text: The receptionist upgraded us, but the room she chose has no desk.
lines.ipa: /ðə ɹɪsˈɛpʃənˌɪst ʌpɡɹˈeɪdɪd ˌʌs bˌʌt ðə ɹˈuːm ʃiː tʃˈəʊz hɐz nˈəʊ dˈɛsk/

lines.speaker: B
lines.text: Most guests prefer the extra floor space.
lines.ipa: /mˈəʊst ɡˈɛsts pɹɪfˈɜː ðɪ ˈɛkstɹə flˈɔː spˈeɪs/

lines.speaker: A
lines.text: I appreciate the gesture; I just need somewhere to finish a presentation.
lines.ipa: /aɪ ɐpɹˈiːʃɪˌeɪt ðə dʒˈɛstʃə aɪ dʒˈʌst nˈiːd sˈʌmweə tə fˈɪnɪʃ ɐ pɹˌɛzəntˈeɪʃən/

lines.speaker: B
lines.text: Let me restore the room you booked, unless we can add a proper desk.
lines.ipa: /lˈɛt mˌiː ɹɪstˈɔː ðə ɹˈuːm juː bˈʊkt ʌnlˈɛs wiː kan ˈad ɐ pɹˈɒpə dˈɛsk/

lines.speaker: A
lines.text: The breakfast buffet is magnificent if you've got nowhere to be.
lines.ipa: /ðə bɹˈɛkfəst bˈʌfɪt ɪz maɡnˈɪfɪsənt ɪf juːv ɡɒt nˈəʊweə tə bˈiː/

lines.speaker: B
lines.text: You were hoping for something you could eat in ten minutes?
lines.ipa: /juː wɜː hˈəʊpɪŋ fɔː sˈʌmθɪŋ juː kʊd ˈiːt ɪn tˈɛn mˈɪnɪts/

lines.speaker: A
lines.text: Exactly. Queuing for three separate stations rather defeated that ambition.
lines.ipa: /ɛɡzˈaktli kjˈuːɪŋ fɔː θɹˈiː sˈɛpɹət stˈeɪʃənz ɹˈɑːðə dɪfˈiːtɪd ðat ambˈɪʃən/

lines.speaker: B
lines.text: Tomorrow I'll point you towards the quieter service by the side entrance.
lines.ipa: /təmˈɒɹəʊ aɪl pˈɔɪnt juː təwˈɔːdz ðə kwˈaɪətə sˈɜːvɪs baɪ ðə sˈaɪd ˈɛntɹəns/

lines.speaker: A
lines.text: Everyone calls the room quiet, but the noise is intermittent rather than absent.
lines.ipa: /ˈɛvɹɪwˌɒn kˈɔːlz ðə ɹˈuːm kwˈaɪət bˌʌt ðə nˈɔɪz ɪz ˌɪntəmˈɪtənt ɹˈɑːðə ðɐn ˈabsənt/

lines.speaker: B
lines.text: So it keeps waking you just as you settle?
lines.ipa: /sˌəʊ ɪt kˈiːps wˈeɪkɪŋ juː dʒˈʌst az juː sˈɛtəl/

lines.speaker: A
lines.text: That's it. I could probably sleep through a steady hum.
lines.ipa: /ðatsˈɪt aɪ kʊd pɹˈɒbəbli slˈiːp θɹuː ɐ stˈɛdi hˈʌm/

lines.speaker: B
lines.text: I'll note the timing of the disturbance when I ask about moving you.
lines.ipa: /aɪl nˈəʊt ðə tˈaɪmɪŋ ɒvðə dɪstˈɜːbəns wɛn aɪ ˈask ɐbˌaʊt mˈuːvɪŋ juː/

lines.speaker: A
lines.text: We don't need late checkout if you can keep a small item secure.
lines.ipa: /wiː dˈəʊnt nˈiːd lˈeɪt tʃˈɛkaʊt ɪf juː kan kˈiːp ɐ smˈɔːl ˈaɪtəm sɪkjˈʊə/

lines.speaker: B
lines.text: Something more valuable than ordinary luggage?
lines.ipa: /sˈʌmθɪŋ mˈɔː vˈaljuːəbəl ðɐn ˈɔːdɪnəɹi lˈʌɡɪdʒ/

lines.speaker: A
lines.text: A musical instrument. Leaving it in an open pile would make me nervous.
lines.ipa: /ɐ mjˈuːzɪkəl ˈɪnstɹəmənt lˈiːvɪŋ ɪt ɪn ɐn ˈəʊpən pˈaɪl wʊd mˌeɪk mˌiː nˈɜːvəs/

lines.speaker: B
lines.text: We have a locked room, and I'll give you a receipt identifying the case.
lines.ipa: /wiː hav ɐ lˈɒkt ɹˈuːm and aɪl ɡˈɪv juː ɐ ɹɪsˈiːt aɪdˈɛntɪfˌaɪɪŋ ðə kˈeɪs/

lines.speaker: A
lines.text: I borrowed a charger and somehow acquired responsibility for a whole box of cables.
lines.ipa: /aɪ bˈɒɹəʊd ɐ tʃˈɑːdʒə and sˈʌmhaʊ ɐkwˈaɪəd ɹɪspˌɒnsəbˈɪlɪti fəɹə hˈəʊl bˈɒks ɒv kˈeɪbəlz/

lines.speaker: B
lines.text: Did reception ask you to identify which one worked?
lines.ipa: /dˈɪd ɹɪsˈɛpʃən ˈask juː tʊ aɪdˈɛntɪfˌaɪ wˌɪtʃ wˈɒn wˈɜːkt/

lines.speaker: A
lines.text: Yes, but now nobody knows which ones belonged to me.
lines.ipa: /jˈɛs bˌʌt nˈaʊ nˈəʊbɒdi nˈəʊz wˌɪtʃ wˈɒnz bɪlˈɒŋd tə mˌiː/

lines.speaker: B
lines.text: Let's separate what you recognise before we try to count anything.
lines.ipa: /lˈɛts sˈɛpɹət wɒt juː ɹˈɛkəɡnˌaɪz bɪfˌɔː wiː tɹˈaɪ tə kˈaʊnt ˈɛnɪθˌɪŋ/

lines.speaker: A
lines.text: The laundry returned my suit beautifully pressed and still slightly damp.
lines.ipa: /ðə lˈɔːndɹi ɹɪtˈɜːnd maɪ sˈuːt bjˈuːtɪfəli pɹˈɛst and stˈɪl slˈaɪtli dˈamp/

lines.speaker: B
lines.text: Did they rush it to meet your departure time?
lines.ipa: /dˈɪd ðeɪ ɹˈʌʃ ɪt tə mˈiːt jɔː dɪpˈɑːtʃə tˈaɪm/

lines.speaker: A
lines.text: They did, although I would have preferred being told it wouldn't be ready.
lines.ipa: /ðeɪ dˈɪd ɔːlðˈəʊ aɪ wʊdhɐv pɹɪfˈɜːd bˌiːɪŋ tˈəʊld ɪt wˈʊdənt biː ɹˈɛdi/

lines.speaker: B
lines.text: I'll ask them to explain the limitation directly rather than make the decision for you.
lines.ipa: /aɪl ˈask ðˌɛm tʊ ɛksplˈeɪn ðə lˌɪmɪtˈeɪʃən daɪɹˈɛktli ɹˈɑːðə ðɐn mˌeɪk ðə dɪsˈɪʒən fɔː juː/

lines.speaker: A
lines.text: We can change the dates, but we'd lose the purpose of the trip.
lines.ipa: /wiː kan tʃˈeɪndʒ ðə dˈeɪts bˌʌt wiːd lˈuːz ðə pˈɜːpəs ɒvðə tɹˈɪp/

lines.speaker: B
lines.text: The booking is tied to an exhibition that's moved venues, isn't it?
lines.ipa: /ðə bˈʊkɪŋ ɪz tˈaɪd tʊ ɐn ɛksɪbˈɪʃən ðats mˈuːvd vˈɛnjuːz ˈɪzənt ɪt/

lines.speaker: A
lines.text: Yes. A free date change at the wrong location isn't much of an alternative.
lines.ipa: /jˈɛs ɐ fɹˈiː dˈeɪt tʃˈeɪndʒ at ðə ɹˈɒŋ ləʊkˈeɪʃən ˌɪzənt mˈʌtʃ əvən ɔːltˈɜːnətˌɪv/

lines.speaker: B
lines.text: Then we need to discuss suitability, not just availability.
lines.ipa: /ðˈɛn wiː nˈiːd tə dɪskˈʌs sˌuːtəbˈɪlɪti nˌɒt dʒˈʌst ɐvˌeɪləbˈɪlɪti/

lines.speaker: A
lines.text: I know the desk was busy, but announcing my room number across the lobby felt unnecessary.
lines.ipa: /aɪ nˈəʊ ðə dˈɛsk wɒz bˈɪzi bˌʌt ɐnˈaʊnsɪŋ maɪ ɹˈuːm nˈʌmbəɹ əkɹˌɒs ðə lˈɒbi fˈɛlt ʌnnˈɛsɪsəɹi/

lines.speaker: B
lines.text: You're right. We can confirm it discreetly on the card sleeve.
lines.ipa: /jɔː ɹˈaɪt wiː kan kənfˈɜːm ɪt dɪskɹˈiːtli ɒnðə kˈɑːd slˈiːv/

lines.speaker: A
lines.text: I didn't want to embarrass the receptionist in front of a queue.
lines.ipa: /aɪ dˈɪdnt wˈɒnt tʊ ɛmbˈaɹəs ðə ɹɪsˈɛpʃənˌɪst ɪn fɹˈʌnt əvə kjˈuː/

lines.speaker: B
lines.text: Thank you for telling us privately. I'll address the process with the team.
lines.ipa: /θˈaŋk juː fɔː tˈɛlɪŋ ˌʌs pɹˈaɪvətli aɪl ɐdɹˈɛs ðə pɹˈəʊsɛs wɪððə tˈiːm/

lines.speaker: A
lines.text: Your invoice is correct, but the explanation of the deposit makes it look like a second charge.
lines.ipa: /jɔːɹ ˈɪnvɔɪs ɪz kəɹˈɛkt bˌʌt ðɪ ɛksplɐnˈeɪʃən ɒvðə dɪpˈɒzɪt mˌeɪks ɪt lˈʊk lˈaɪk ɐ sˈɛkənd tʃˈɑːdʒ/

lines.speaker: B
lines.text: Would a separate line showing the release help?
lines.ipa: /wʊd ɐ sˈɛpɹət lˈaɪn ʃˈəʊɪŋ ðə ɹɪlˈiːs hˈɛlp/

lines.speaker: A
lines.text: Yes. Our accounts team needs to see what happened, not guess from the total.
lines.ipa: /jˈɛs ˌaʊəɹ ɐkˈaʊnts tˈiːm nˈiːdz tə sˈiː wɒt hˈapənd nˌɒt ɡˈɛs fɹʌmðə tˈəʊtəl/

lines.speaker: B
lines.text: I'll include both the transaction date and the release note.
lines.ipa: /aɪl ɪŋklˈuːd bˈəʊθ ðə tɹansˈakʃən dˈeɪt and ðə ɹɪlˈiːs nˈəʊt/

lines.speaker: A
lines.text: I was about to describe the hotel as disappointing, which isn't quite fair.
lines.ipa: /aɪ wɒz ɐbˌaʊt tə dɪskɹˈaɪb ðə həʊtˈɛl az dˌɪsɐpˈɔɪntɪŋ wˌɪtʃ ˌɪzənt kwˈaɪt fˈeə/

lines.speaker: B
lines.text: What disappointed you specifically?
lines.ipa: /wˌɒt dˌɪsɐpˈɔɪntɪd juː spəsˈɪfɪkli/

lines.speaker: A
lines.text: The photographs promised seclusion; the place itself was friendly and lively.
lines.ipa: /ðə fˈəʊtəɡɹˌafz pɹˈɒmɪst sɪklˈuːʒən ðə plˈeɪs ɪtsˈɛlf wɒz fɹˈɛndli and lˈaɪvlɪ/

lines.speaker: B
lines.text: Then that mismatch is probably more useful than a single broad judgement.
lines.ipa: /ðˈɛn ðat mɪsmˈatʃ ɪz pɹˈɒbəbli mˈɔː jˈuːsfəl ðˌanə sˈɪŋɡəl bɹˈɔːd dʒˈʌdʒmənt/

lines.speaker: A
lines.text: This shirt looks convincing until I try to move my arms.
lines.ipa: /ðɪs ʃˈɜːt lˈʊks kənvˈɪnsɪŋ ʌntˈɪl aɪ tɹˈaɪ tə mˈuːv maɪ ˈɑːmz/

lines.speaker: B
lines.text: A fitting-room mirror rarely asks you to reach for a shelf.
lines.ipa: /ɐ fˈɪtɪŋɹˈuːm mˈɪɹə ɹˈeəli ˈasks juː tə ɹˈiːtʃ fəɹə ʃˈɛlf/

lines.speaker: A
lines.text: Exactly. Standing still, I could persuade myself it's perfect.
lines.ipa: /ɛɡzˈaktli stˈandɪŋ stˈɪl aɪ kʊd pəswˈeɪd maɪsˈɛlf ɪts pˈɜːfɛkt/

lines.speaker: B
lines.text: Try the larger size while carrying your bag. Clothes have to survive ordinary movement.
lines.ipa: /tɹˈaɪ ðə lˈɑːdʒə sˈaɪz wˌaɪl kˈaɹiɪŋ jɔː bˈaɡ klˈəʊðz hav tə səvˈaɪv ˈɔːdɪnəɹi mˈuːvmənt/

lines.speaker: A
lines.text: The exchange policy is generous on paper and surprisingly narrow in practice.
lines.ipa: /ðɪ ɛkstʃˈeɪndʒ pˈɒlɪsi ɪz dʒˈɛnəɹəs ˌɒn pˈeɪpə and səpɹˈaɪzɪŋli nˈaɹəʊ ɪn pɹˈaktɪs/

lines.speaker: B
lines.text: Which condition changed the answer?
lines.ipa: /wˌɪtʃ kəndˈɪʃən tʃˈeɪndʒd ðɪ ˈansə/

lines.speaker: A
lines.text: The item was a gift, and the purchaser lives abroad.
lines.ipa: /ðɪ ˈaɪtəm wʌzɐ ɡˈɪft and ðə pˈɜːtʃɪsə lˈaɪvz ɐbɹˈɔːd/

lines.speaker: B
lines.text: Then the policy needs to account for the way gifts are actually given.
lines.ipa: /ðˈɛn ðə pˈɒlɪsi nˈiːdz tʊ ɐkˈaʊnt fəðə wˈeɪ ɡˈɪfts ɑːɹ ˈaktʃuːəli ɡˈɪvən/

lines.speaker: A
lines.text: I'm suspicious of a sale that never seems to end.
lines.ipa: /aɪm səspˈɪʃəs əvə sˈeɪl ðat nˈɛvə sˈiːmz tʊ ˈɛnd/

lines.speaker: B
lines.text: Perhaps the reduced price has effectively become the normal price.
lines.ipa: /pəhˈaps ðə ɹɪdjˈuːst pɹˈaɪs hɐz ɪfˈɛktɪvli bɪkˌʌm ðə nˈɔːməl pɹˈaɪs/

lines.speaker: A
lines.text: That's why the claimed saving doesn't help me judge the offer.
lines.ipa: /ðats wˌaɪ ðə klˈeɪmd sˈeɪvɪŋ dˈʌzənt hˈɛlp mˌiː dʒˈʌdʒ ðɪ ˈɒfə/

lines.speaker: B
lines.text: Ignore the crossed-out figure and compare what you'd pay elsewhere today.
lines.ipa: /ɪɡnˈɔː ðə kɹˈɒstˈaʊt fˈɪɡə and kəmpˈeə wɒt juːd pˈeɪ ˈɛlsweə tədˈeɪ/

lines.speaker: A
lines.text: The repair fixed the original fault and introduced a noise I hadn't heard before.
lines.ipa: /ðə ɹɪpˈeə fˈɪkst ðɪ əɹˈɪdʒɪnəl fˈɒlt and ˌɪntɹədjˈuːst ɐ nˈɔɪz aɪ hˈadənt hˈɜːd bɪfˈɔː/

lines.speaker: B
lines.text: Has the technician listened to it operating normally?
lines.ipa: /hɐz ðə tɛknˈɪʃən lˈɪsənd tʊ ɪt ˈɒpəɹˌeɪtɪŋ nˈɔːməli/

lines.speaker: A
lines.text: Only for a few seconds at the counter.
lines.ipa: /ˈəʊnli fəɹə fjˈuː sˈɛkəndz at ðə kˈaʊntə/

lines.speaker: B
lines.text: Ask for the test to reproduce your use, not just demonstrate that it switches on.
lines.ipa: /ˈask fəðə tˈɛst tə ɹɪpɹədjˈuːs jɔː jˈuːs nˌɒt dʒˈʌst dˈɛmənstɹˌeɪt ðˌatɪt swˈɪtʃɪz ˈɒn/

lines.speaker: A
lines.text: The collection system sent me a reminder while I was standing in the queue to collect.
lines.ipa: /ðə kəlˈɛkʃən sˈɪstəm sˈɛnt mˌiː ɐ ɹɪmˈaɪndə wˌaɪl aɪ wɒz stˈandɪŋ ɪnðə kjˈuː tə kəlˈɛkt/

lines.speaker: B
lines.text: At least it knows you're committed.
lines.ipa: /at lˈiːst ɪt nˈəʊz jɔː kəmˈɪtɪd/

lines.speaker: A
lines.text: It also warned that the order would expire in fifteen minutes.
lines.ipa: /ɪt ˈɔːlsəʊ wˈɔːnd ðatðɪ ˈɔːdə wʊd ɛkspˈaɪəɹ ɪn fˈɪftiːn mˈɪnɪts/

lines.speaker: B
lines.text: Tell the desk you're present. An automatic deadline shouldn't turn a queue into a lottery.
lines.ipa: /tˈɛl ðə dˈɛsk jɔː pɹˈɛzənt ɐn ˌɔːtəmˈatɪk dˈɛdlaɪn ʃˌʊdənt tˈɜːn ɐ kjˈuː ˌɪntʊ ɐ lˈɒtəɹi/

lines.speaker: A
lines.text: I'd like the gift wrapped without making it impossible for the recipient to return.
lines.ipa: /aɪd lˈaɪk ðə ɡˈɪft ɹˈapt wɪðˌaʊt mˌeɪkɪŋ ɪt ɪmpˈɒsɪbəl fəðə ɹɪsˈɪpiənt tə ɹɪtˈɜːn/

lines.speaker: B
lines.text: The ribbon can stay separate from the seal.
lines.ipa: /ðə ɹˈɪbən kan stˈeɪ sˈɛpɹət fɹʌmðə sˈiːl/

lines.speaker: A
lines.text: That would be ideal. I want a pleasant surprise, not a test of loyalty.
lines.ipa: /ðat wʊd biː aɪdˈiəl aɪ wˈɒnt ɐ plˈɛzənt səpɹˈaɪz nˌɒtə tˈɛst ɒv lˈɔɪəlti/

lines.speaker: B
lines.text: I'll include the gift receipt in an envelope rather than attach it to the outside.
lines.ipa: /aɪl ɪŋklˈuːd ðə ɡˈɪft ɹɪsˈiːt ɪn ɐn ˈɛnvəlˌəʊp ɹˈɑːðə ðɐn ɐtˈatʃ ɪt tə ðɪ aʊtsˈaɪd/

lines.speaker: A
lines.text: The voucher persuaded me to buy something I hadn't particularly wanted.
lines.ipa: /ðə vˈaʊtʃə pəswˈeɪdɪd mˌiː tə bˈaɪ sˈʌmθɪŋ aɪ hˈadənt pətˈɪkjʊləli wˈɒntɪd/

lines.speaker: B
lines.text: Was the discount large enough to justify that?
lines.ipa: /wʌzðə dˈɪskaʊnt lˈɑːdʒ ɪnˈʌf tə dʒˈʌstɪfˌaɪ ðˈat/

lines.speaker: A
lines.text: Only if wanting to use the voucher counts as needing the product.
lines.ipa: /ˈəʊnli ɪf wˈɒntɪŋ tə jˈuːz ðə vˈaʊtʃə kˈaʊnts az nˈiːdɪŋ ðə pɹˈɒdʌkt/

lines.speaker: B
lines.text: Perhaps keep it until there's a purchase you'd make without encouragement.
lines.ipa: /pəhˈaps kˈiːp ɪt ʌntˈɪl ðeəz ɐ pˈɜːtʃɪs juːd mˌeɪk wɪðˌaʊt ɛŋkˈʌɹɪdʒmənt/

lines.speaker: A
lines.text: The second-hand chair is beautifully restored, but the seller has removed every sign of age.
lines.ipa: /ðə sˈɛkəndhˈand tʃˈeəɹ ɪz bjˈuːtɪfəli ɹɪstˈɔːd bˌʌt ðə sˈɛlə hɐz ɹɪmˈuːvd ˈɛvɹɪ sˈaɪn ɒv ˈeɪdʒ/

lines.speaker: B
lines.text: You liked it partly because it looked used?
lines.ipa: /juː lˈaɪkt ɪt pˈɑːtli bɪkˈɒz ɪt lˈʊkt jˈuːzd/

lines.speaker: A
lines.text: Yes. Now it's an old chair trying very hard to look new.
lines.ipa: /jˈɛs nˈaʊ ɪts ɐn ˈəʊld tʃˈeə tɹˈaɪɪŋ vˈɛɹi hˈɑːd tə lˈʊk njˈuː/

lines.speaker: B
lines.text: Then you're looking for a different kind of restoration, not necessarily a better bargain.
lines.ipa: /ðˈɛn jɔː lˈʊkɪŋ fəɹə dˈɪfɹənt kˈaɪnd ɒv ɹˌɛstəɹˈeɪʃən nˌɒt nˌɛsɪsˈɛɹɪli ɐ bˈɛtə bˈɑːɡɪn/

lines.speaker: A
lines.text: They offered recyclable packaging, but only as a paid upgrade.
lines.ipa: /ðeɪ ˈɒfəd ɹɪsˈaɪkələbəl pˈakɪdʒɪŋ bˌʌt ˈəʊnli az ɐ pˈeɪd ˈʌpɡɹeɪd/

lines.speaker: B
lines.text: That makes the standard option sound rather difficult to defend.
lines.ipa: /ðat mˌeɪks ðə stˈandəd ˈɒpʃən sˈaʊnd ɹˈɑːðə dˈɪfɪkəlt tə dɪfˈɛnd/

lines.speaker: A
lines.text: Especially when the upgrade uses less material.
lines.ipa: /ɪspˈɛʃəli wɛn ðɪ ˈʌpɡɹeɪd jˈuːsɪz lˈɛs mətˈiəɹiəl/

lines.speaker: B
lines.text: Ask what the charge actually covers before accepting the label as an explanation.
lines.ipa: /ˈask wɒt ðə tʃˈɑːdʒ ˈaktʃuːəli kˈʌvəz bɪfˌɔːɹ ɐksˈɛptɪŋ ðə lˈeɪbəl az ɐn ɛksplɐnˈeɪʃən/

lines.speaker: A
lines.text: The pre-order gives access to an exclusive edition I don't like as much.
lines.ipa: /ðə pɹˈiːˈɔːdə ɡˈɪvz ˈaksɛs tʊ ɐn ɛksklˈuːsɪv ɪdˈɪʃən aɪ dˈəʊnt lˈaɪk az mˈʌtʃ/

lines.speaker: B
lines.text: You're considering it because it's limited?
lines.ipa: /jɔː kənsˈɪdəɹɪŋ ɪt bɪkˈɒz ɪts lˈɪmɪtɪd/

lines.speaker: A
lines.text: I know how that sounds.
lines.ipa: /aɪ nˈəʊ hˌaʊ ðat sˈaʊndz/

lines.speaker: B
lines.text: Then compare the books with the promotional labels covered up. Choose the one you'd want to read.
lines.ipa: /ðˈɛn kəmpˈeə ðə bˈʊks wɪððə pɹəmˈəʊʃənəl lˈeɪbəlz kˈʌvəd ˈʌp tʃˈuːz ðə wˈɒn juːd wˈɒnt tə ɹˈiːd/

lines.speaker: A
lines.text: We've become so polite about the cleaning that nothing gets said until someone's furious.
lines.ipa: /wiːv bɪkˌʌm sˌəʊ pəlˈaɪt ɐbˌaʊt ðə klˈiːnɪŋ ðat nˈʌθɪŋ ɡˈɛts sˈɛd ʌntˈɪl sˈʌmwɒnz fjˈʊəɹiəs/

lines.speaker: B
lines.text: Does the rota help, or simply give everyone evidence for their case?
lines.ipa: /dˈʌz ðə ɹˈəʊtə hˈɛlp ɔː sˈɪmpli ɡˈɪv ˈɛvɹɪwˌɒn ˈɛvɪdəns fɔː ðeə kˈeɪs/

lines.speaker: A
lines.text: Mostly evidence, unfortunately.
lines.ipa: /mˈəʊstli ˈɛvɪdəns ʌnfˈɔːtʃənətli/

lines.speaker: B
lines.text: Then the first task is agreeing how to raise a problem before it becomes a prosecution.
lines.ipa: /ðˈɛn ðə fˈɜːst tˈask ɪz ɐɡɹˈiːɪŋ hˌaʊ tə ɹˈeɪz ɐ pɹˈɒbləm bɪfˌɔːɹ ɪt bɪkˌʌmz ɐ pɹˌɒsɪkjˈuːʃən/

lines.speaker: A
lines.text: The leak disappears whenever the person sent to inspect it arrives.
lines.ipa: /ðə lˈiːk dˌɪsɐpˈiəz wɛnˌɛvə ðə pˈɜːsən sˈɛnt tʊ ɪnspˈɛkt ɪt ɐɹˈaɪvz/

lines.speaker: B
lines.text: Like a remarkably shy plumbing fault.
lines.ipa: /lˈaɪk ɐ ɹɪmˈɑːkəbli ʃˈaɪ plˈʌmɪŋ fˈɒlt/

lines.speaker: A
lines.text: I've started taking timed photographs so the conversation isn't just my memory against a dry cupboard.
lines.ipa: /aɪv stˈɑːtɪd tˈeɪkɪŋ tˈaɪmd fˈəʊtəɡɹˌafz sˌəʊ ðə kɒnvəsˈeɪʃən ˌɪzənt dʒˈʌst maɪ mˈɛməɹi ɐɡˈɛnst ɐ dɹˈaɪ kˈʌbəd/

lines.speaker: B
lines.text: Good. Evidence of an intermittent problem needs to show the interval.
lines.ipa: /ɡˈʊd ˈɛvɪdəns əvən ˌɪntəmˈɪtənt pɹˈɒbləm nˈiːdz tə ʃˈəʊ ðɪ ˈɪntəvəl/

lines.speaker: A
lines.text: I'd happily lend him the ladder again if he'd acknowledge what happened last time.
lines.ipa: /aɪd hˈapɪli lˈɛnd hˌɪm ðə lˈadəɹ ɐɡˈɛn ɪf hiːd ɐknˈɒlɪdʒ wɒt hˈapənd lˈast tˈaɪm/

lines.speaker: B
lines.text: So the repair cost isn't the whole issue.
lines.ipa: /sˌəʊ ðə ɹɪpˈeə kˈɒst ˌɪzənt ðə hˈəʊl ˈɪʃuː/

lines.speaker: A
lines.text: No. Being told I imagined the damage made a small accident much harder to settle.
lines.ipa: /nˈəʊ bˌiːɪŋ tˈəʊld aɪ ɪmˈadʒɪnd ðə dˈamɪdʒ mˌeɪd ɐ smˈɔːl ˈaksɪdənt mˈʌtʃ hˈɑːdə tə sˈɛtəl/

lines.speaker: B
lines.text: Then be honest about that rather than negotiating only over the broken step.
lines.ipa: /ðˈɛn biː ˈɒnɪst ɐbˌaʊt ðat ɹˈɑːðə ðɐn nɪɡˈəʊʃɪˌeɪtɪŋ ˈəʊnli ˌəʊvə ðə bɹˈəʊkən stˈɛp/

lines.speaker: A
lines.text: Our neighbour accepts every parcel, then seems offended when we ask to collect them.
lines.ipa: /ˌaʊə nˈeɪbəɹ ɐksˈɛpts ˈɛvɹɪ pˈɑːsəl ðˈɛn sˈiːmz əfˈɛndɪd wɛn wiː ˈask tə kəlˈɛkt ðˌɛm/

lines.speaker: B
lines.text: Maybe being helpful has turned into a job they didn't expect.
lines.ipa: /mˈeɪbiː bˌiːɪŋ hˈɛlpfəl hɐz tˈɜːnd ˌɪntʊ ɐ dʒˈɒb ðeɪ dˈɪdnt ɛkspˈɛkt/

lines.speaker: A
lines.text: That's plausible. We keep thanking them and making it worse.
lines.ipa: /ðats plˈɔːzɪbəl wiː kˈiːp θˈaŋkɪŋ ðˌɛm and mˌeɪkɪŋ ɪt wˈɜːs/

lines.speaker: B
lines.text: Offer an alternative arrangement, not a larger box of chocolates.
lines.ipa: /ˈɒfəɹ ɐn ɔːltˈɜːnətˌɪv ɐɹˈeɪndʒmənt nˌɒtə lˈɑːdʒə bˈɒks ɒv tʃˈɒkləts/

lines.speaker: A
lines.text: I can hear my neighbour's conversations clearly, but I'd rather they didn't know how clearly.
lines.ipa: /aɪ kan hˈiə maɪ nˈeɪbəz kɒnvəsˈeɪʃənz klˈiəli bˌʌt aɪd ɹˈɑːðə ðeɪ dˈɪdnt nˈəʊ hˌaʊ klˈiəli/

lines.speaker: B
lines.text: You need to discuss the wall without demonstrating the problem word for word.
lines.ipa: /juː nˈiːd tə dɪskˈʌs ðə wˈɔːl wɪðˌaʊt dˈɛmənstɹˌeɪtɪŋ ðə pɹˈɒbləm wˈɜːd fɔː wˈɜːd/

lines.speaker: A
lines.text: Precisely. I don't want a soundproofing request to sound like surveillance.
lines.ipa: /pɹɪsˈaɪsli aɪ dˈəʊnt wˈɒnt ɐ sˈaʊndpɹuːfɪŋ ɹɪkwˈɛst tə sˈaʊnd lˈaɪk səvˈeɪləns/

lines.speaker: B
lines.text: Stick to when the noise carries and how it affects the room.
lines.ipa: /stˈɪk tə wɛn ðə nˈɔɪz kˈaɹiz and hˌaʊ ɪt ɐfˈɛkts ðə ɹˈuːm/

lines.speaker: A
lines.text: The prospective flatmate asked more about our habits than about the furniture.
lines.ipa: /ðə pɹəspˈɛktɪv flˈatmeɪt ˈaskt mˈɔːɹ ɐbˌaʊt ˌaʊə hˈabɪts ðɐn ɐbˌaʊt ðə fˈɜːnɪtʃə/

lines.speaker: B
lines.text: That sounds promising.
lines.ipa: /ðat sˈaʊndz pɹˈɒmɪsɪŋ/

lines.speaker: A
lines.text: It was. We discovered we had completely different ideas about having friends round.
lines.ipa: /ɪt wˈɒz wiː dɪskˈʌvəd wiː had kəmplˈiːtli dˈɪfɹənt aɪdˈiəz ɐbˌaʊt hˌavɪŋ fɹˈɛndz ɹˈaʊnd/

lines.speaker: B
lines.text: Finding that out politely is better than finding it out after they've moved in.
lines.ipa: /fˈaɪndɪŋ ðat ˈaʊt pəlˈaɪtli ɪz bˈɛtə ðɐn fˈaɪndɪŋ ɪt ˈaʊt ˈaftə ðeɪv mˈuːvd ˈɪn/

lines.speaker: A
lines.text: I've labelled every moving box except the one containing the labels.
lines.ipa: /aɪv lˈeɪbəld ˈɛvɹɪ mˈuːvɪŋ bˈɒks ɛksˈɛpt ðə wˈɒn kəntˈeɪnɪŋ ðə lˈeɪbəlz/

lines.speaker: B
lines.text: A practical demonstration of why systems need a recovery plan.
lines.ipa: /ɐ pɹˈaktɪkəl dˌɛmənstɹˈeɪʃən ɒv wˌaɪ sˈɪstəmz nˈiːd ɐ ɹɪkˈʌvəɹi plˈan/

lines.speaker: A
lines.text: The recovery plan is currently opening boxes until something looks familiar.
lines.ipa: /ðə ɹɪkˈʌvəɹi plˈan ɪz kˈʌɹəntli ˈəʊpənɪŋ bˈɒksɪz ʌntˈɪl sˈʌmθɪŋ lˈʊks fəmˈɪliə/

lines.speaker: B
lines.text: Start with what you'll need tonight. The filing system can recover tomorrow.
lines.ipa: /stˈɑːt wɪð wɒt juːl nˈiːd tənˈaɪt ðə fˈaɪlɪŋ sˈɪstəm kan ɹɪkˈʌvə təmˈɒɹəʊ/

lines.speaker: A
lines.text: The heating controls offer an impressive number of settings, none of which I understand.
lines.ipa: /ðə hˈiːtɪŋ kəntɹˈəʊlz ˈɒfəɹ ɐn ɪmpɹˈɛsɪv nˈʌmbəɹ ɒv sˈɛtɪŋz nˈɒn ɒvwˈɪtʃ aɪ ˌʌndəstˈand/

lines.speaker: B
lines.text: Have you found the simple schedule option?
lines.ipa: /hav juː fˈaʊnd ðə sˈɪmpəl ʃˈɛdjuːl ˈɒpʃən/

lines.speaker: A
lines.text: Yes, hidden under advanced preferences.
lines.ipa: /jˈɛs hˈɪdən ˌʌndəɹ ɐdvˈanst pɹˈɛfɹənsɪz/

lines.speaker: B
lines.text: Perhaps the most useful feature is the one the interface is least proud of.
lines.ipa: /pəhˈaps ðə mˈəʊst jˈuːsfəl fˈiːtʃəɹ ɪz ðə wˈɒn ðɪ ˈɪntəfˌeɪs ɪz lˈiːst pɹˈaʊd ɒv/

lines.speaker: A
lines.text: The letting agent called the new terms standard, as if that settled whether they suited us.
lines.ipa: /ðə lˈɛtɪŋ ˈeɪdʒənt kˈɔːld ðə njˈuː tˈɜːmz stˈandəd az ɪf ðat sˈɛtəld wˈɛðə ðeɪ sˈuːtɪd ˌʌs/

lines.speaker: B
lines.text: Standard for whom?
lines.ipa: /stˈandəd fɔː hˈuːm/

lines.speaker: A
lines.text: Exactly. I don't object to reading a standard agreement; I object to being discouraged from reading it.
lines.ipa: /ɛɡzˈaktli aɪ dˈəʊnt ɒbdʒˈɛkt tə ɹˈiːdɪŋ ɐ stˈandəd ɐɡɹˈiːmənt aɪ ɒbdʒˈɛkt tə bˌiːɪŋ dɪskˈʌɹɪdʒd fɹɒm ɹˈiːdɪŋ ɪt/

lines.speaker: B
lines.text: Ask them to identify the changes rather than summarise the document with a label.
lines.ipa: /ˈask ðˌɛm tʊ aɪdˈɛntɪfˌaɪ ðə tʃˈeɪndʒɪz ɹˈɑːðə ðɐn sˈʌməɹˌaɪz ðə dˈɒkjuːmənt wɪð ɐ lˈeɪbəl/

lines.speaker: A
lines.text: Our dog likes the sitter so much that I felt slightly replaced.
lines.ipa: /ˌaʊə dˈɒɡ lˈaɪks ðə sˈɪtə sˈəʊ mˌʌtʃ ðat aɪ fˈɛlt slˈaɪtli ɹɪplˈeɪst/

lines.speaker: B
lines.text: That's a fairly successful outcome for the dog.
lines.ipa: /ðats ɐ fˈeəli səksˈɛsfəl ˈaʊtkʌm fəðə dˈɒɡ/

lines.speaker: A
lines.text: I know. I just wasn't prepared for him to be delighted when we left.
lines.ipa: /aɪ nˈəʊ aɪ dʒˈʌst wˌɒzn̩t pɹɪpˈeəd fɔː hˌɪm təbi dɪlˈaɪtɪd wɛn wiː lˈɛft/

lines.speaker: B
lines.text: You hired someone to make him comfortable. Try to enjoy the evidence that it worked.
lines.ipa: /juː hˈaɪəd sˈʌmwɒn tə mˌeɪk hˌɪm kˈʌmftəbəl tɹˈaɪ tʊ ɛndʒˈɔɪ ðɪ ˈɛvɪdəns ðˌatɪt wˈɜːkt/

lines.speaker: A
lines.text: I was offered an earlier appointment at a location I couldn't reach.
lines.ipa: /aɪ wɒz ˈɒfəd ɐn ˈɜːlɪəɹ ɐpˈɔɪntmənt atə ləʊkˈeɪʃən aɪ kˌʊdənt ɹˈiːtʃ/

lines.speaker: B
lines.text: Did declining it put you back at the end of the list?
lines.ipa: /dˈɪd dɪklˈaɪnɪŋ ɪt pˌʊt juː bˈak at ðɪ ˈɛnd ɒvðə lˈɪst/

lines.speaker: A
lines.text: That's what the message implied, although it never actually said so.
lines.ipa: /ðats wɒt ðə mˈɛsɪdʒ ɪmplˈaɪd ɔːlðˈəʊ ɪt nˈɛvəɹ ˈaktʃuːəli sˈɛd sˈəʊ/

lines.speaker: B
lines.text: Ask for clarification. An unsuitable offer shouldn't look like a choice you freely rejected.
lines.ipa: /ˈask fɔː klˌaɹɪfɪkˈeɪʃən ɐn ʌnsˈuːtəbəl ˈɒfə ʃˌʊdənt lˈʊk lˈaɪk ɐ tʃˈɔɪs juː fɹˈiːli ɹɪdʒˈɛktɪd/

lines.speaker: A
lines.text: The instructor remembered everyone's limitations without making a performance of accommodating them.
lines.ipa: /ðɪ ɪnstɹˈʌktə ɹɪmˈɛmbəd ˈɛvɹɪwˌɒnz lˌɪmɪtˈeɪʃənz wɪðˌaʊt mˌeɪkɪŋ ɐ pəfˈɔːməns ɒv ɐkˈɒmədˌeɪtɪŋ ðˌɛm/

lines.speaker: B
lines.text: That can be surprisingly difficult to do well.
lines.ipa: /ðat kan biː səpɹˈaɪzɪŋli dˈɪfɪkəlt tə dˈuː wˈɛl/

lines.speaker: A
lines.text: Nobody had to explain themselves to the whole room before joining in.
lines.ipa: /nˈəʊbɒdi hadtʊ ɛksplˈeɪn ðɛmsˈɛlvz tə ðə hˈəʊl ɹˈuːm bɪfˌɔː dʒˈɔɪnɪŋ ˈɪn/

lines.speaker: B
lines.text: It sounds as though inclusion was built into the session rather than announced as a special favour.
lines.ipa: /ɪt sˈaʊndz az ðˌəʊ ɪŋklˈuːʒən wɒz bˈɪlt ˌɪntʊ ðə sˈɛʃən ɹˈɑːðə ðɐn ɐnˈaʊnst az ɐ spˈɛʃəl fˈeɪvə/

lines.speaker: A
lines.text: I've realised my idea of a restful evening involved completing six things efficiently.
lines.ipa: /aɪv ɹˈiəlaɪzd maɪ aɪdˈiəɹ əvə ɹˈɛstfəl ˈiːvnɪŋ ɪnvˈɒlvd kəmplˈiːtɪŋ sˈɪks θˈɪŋz ɪfˈɪʃəntli/

lines.speaker: B
lines.text: Including resting, presumably.
lines.ipa: /ɪŋklˈuːdɪŋ ɹˈɛstɪŋ pɹɪzjˈuːməbli/

lines.speaker: A
lines.text: Especially resting. I was becoming irritated when it took longer than scheduled.
lines.ipa: /ɪspˈɛʃəli ɹˈɛstɪŋ aɪ wɒz bɪkˈʌmɪŋ ˈɪɹɪtˌeɪtɪd wɛn ɪt tˈʊk lˈɒŋɡə ðɐn ʃˈɛdjuːld/

lines.speaker: B
lines.text: You may have imported the wrong management system into your living room.
lines.ipa: /juː mˌeɪhɐv ɪmpˈɔːtɪd ðə ɹˈɒŋ mˈanɪdʒmənt sˈɪstəm ˌɪntʊ jɔː lˈɪvɪŋ ɹˈuːm/

lines.speaker: A
lines.text: The restaurant manager checked the ingredient information personally and came back with an uncertainty.
lines.ipa: /ðə ɹˈɛstɹɒnt mˈanɪdʒə tʃˈɛkt ðɪ ɪŋɡɹˈiːdiənt ˌɪnfəmˈeɪʃən pˈɜːsənəli and kˈeɪm bˈak wɪð ɐn ʌnsˈɜːtənti/

lines.speaker: B
lines.text: Did that make you less confident in the service?
lines.ipa: /dˈɪd ðat mˌeɪk juː lˈɛs kˈɒnfɪdənt ɪnðə sˈɜːvɪs/

lines.speaker: A
lines.text: Quite the opposite. They told me exactly what they could and couldn't confirm.
lines.ipa: /kwˈaɪt ðɪ ˈɒpəzˌɪt ðeɪ tˈəʊld mˌiː ɛɡzˈaktli wɒt ðeɪ kʊd and kˌʊdənt kənfˈɜːm/

lines.speaker: B
lines.text: A qualified answer can be more trustworthy than effortless certainty.
lines.ipa: /ɐ kwˈɒlɪfˌaɪd ˈansə kan biː mˈɔː tɹˈʌstwɜːði ðɐn ˈɛfətləs sˈɜːtənti/

lines.speaker: A
lines.text: Our walking group advertised a leisurely route and somehow turned it into a race.
lines.ipa: /ˌaʊə wˈɔːkɪŋ ɡɹˈuːp ˈadvətˌaɪzd ɐ lˈɛʒəli ɹˈuːt and sˈʌmhaʊ tˈɜːnd ɪt ˌɪntʊ ɐ ɹˈeɪs/

lines.speaker: B
lines.text: Who set the pace?
lines.ipa: /hˌuː sˈɛt ðə pˈeɪs/

lines.speaker: A
lines.text: The people at the front, who never saw the people at the back.
lines.ipa: /ðə pˈiːpəl at ðə fɹˈʌnt hˌuː nˈɛvə sˈɔː ðə pˈiːpəl at ðə bˈak/

lines.speaker: B
lines.text: Ask someone to lead from the slower end once. It might change what leisurely means to them.
lines.ipa: /ˈask sˈʌmwɒn tə lˈiːd fɹʌmðə slˈəʊəɹ ˈɛnd wˈʌns ɪt mˌaɪt tʃˈeɪndʒ wɒt lˈɛʒəli mˈiːnz tə ðˌɛm/

lines.speaker: A
lines.text: I bought a rather elaborate bottle to remind myself to use the refill points.
lines.ipa: /aɪ bˈɔːt ɐ ɹˈɑːðəɹ ɪlˈabəɹˌeɪt bˈɒtəl tə ɹɪmˈaɪnd maɪsˈɛlf tə jˈuːz ðə ɹɪfˈɪl pˈɔɪnts/

lines.speaker: B
lines.text: And do you?
lines.ipa: /and dˈuː juː/

lines.speaker: A
lines.text: When I remember to carry the bottle, which is the weakness in this elegant arrangement.
lines.ipa: /wˌɛn aɪ ɹɪmˈɛmbə tə kˈaɹi ðə bˈɒtəl wˌɪtʃ ɪz ðə wˈiːknəs ɪn ðɪs ˈɛlɪɡənt ɐɹˈeɪndʒmənt/

lines.speaker: B
lines.text: Perhaps solve the leaving-it-at-home problem before upgrading the equipment again.
lines.ipa: /pəhˈaps sˈɒlv ðə lˈiːvɪŋɪtathˈəʊm pɹˈɒbləm bɪfˌɔːɹ ʌpɡɹˈeɪdɪŋ ðɪ ɪkwˈɪpmənt ɐɡˈɛn/

lines.speaker: A
lines.text: I block out lunch in my calendar, but still apologise when someone asks to book over it.
lines.ipa: /aɪ blˈɒk ˈaʊt lˈʌntʃ ɪn maɪ kˈaləndə bˌʌt stˈɪl ɐpˈɒlədʒˌaɪz wɛn sˈʌmwɒn ˈasks tə bˈʊk ˈəʊvəɹ ɪt/

lines.speaker: B
lines.text: You make your own time sound like an administrative mistake.
lines.ipa: /juː mˌeɪk jɔːɹ ˈəʊn tˈaɪm sˈaʊnd lˈaɪk ɐn ɐdmˈɪnɪstɹətˌɪv mɪstˈeɪk/

lines.speaker: A
lines.text: That's exactly the tone I use.
lines.ipa: /ðats ɛɡzˈaktli ðə tˈəʊn aɪ jˈuːz/

lines.speaker: B
lines.text: Then try stating your availability without supplying a defence for having any.
lines.ipa: /ðˈɛn tɹˈaɪ stˈeɪtɪŋ jɔːɹ ɐvˌeɪləbˈɪlɪti wɪðˌaʊt səplˈaɪɪŋ ɐ dɪfˈɛns fɔː hˈavɪŋ ˌɛni/

lines.speaker: A
lines.text: The replacement class was excellent, though it wasn't what the advert had led me to expect.
lines.ipa: /ðə ɹɪplˈeɪsmənt klˈas wɒz ˈɛksələnt ðˌəʊ ɪt wˌɒzn̩t wɒt ðɪ ˈadvɜːt had lˈɛd mˌiː tʊ ɛkspˈɛkt/

lines.speaker: B
lines.text: Can both those things be true in your feedback?
lines.ipa: /kan bˈəʊθ ðəʊz θˈɪŋz biː tɹˈuː ɪn jɔː fˈiːdbak/

lines.speaker: A
lines.text: They need to be. Praise for the teacher shouldn't imply the description was accurate.
lines.ipa: /ðeɪ nˈiːd tə bˈiː pɹˈeɪz fəðə tˈiːtʃə ʃˌʊdənt ɪmplˈaɪ ðə dɪskɹˈɪpʃən wɒz ˈakjʊɹət/

lines.speaker: B
lines.text: Explain the difference. Future participants may want to know both.
lines.ipa: /ɛksplˈeɪn ðə dˈɪfɹəns fjˈuːtʃə pɑːtˈɪsɪpənts mˈeɪ wˈɒnt tə nˈəʊ bˈəʊθ/

lines.speaker: A
lines.text: I've met the target and feel oddly reluctant to set another one.
lines.ipa: /aɪv mˈɛt ðə tˈɑːɡɪt and fˈiːl ˈɒdli ɹɪlˈʌktənt tə sˈɛt ɐnˈʌðə wˌɒn/

lines.speaker: B
lines.text: Perhaps you want to keep doing the activity without constantly escalating it.
lines.ipa: /pəhˈaps juː wˈɒnt tə kˈiːp dˌuːɪŋ ðɪ aktˈɪvɪti wɪðˌaʊt kˈɒnstəntli ˈɛskɐlˌeɪtɪŋ ɪt/

lines.speaker: A
lines.text: That sounds almost irresponsible when you say it aloud.
lines.ipa: /ðat sˈaʊndz ˈɔːlməʊst ɪɹɪspˈɒnsɪbəl wɛn juː sˈeɪ ɪt ɐlˈaʊd/

lines.speaker: B
lines.text: Only if improvement is the sole reason you're allowed to enjoy something.
lines.ipa: /ˈəʊnli ɪf ɪmpɹˈuːvmənt ɪz ðə sˈəʊl ɹˈiːzən jɔːɹ ɐlˈaʊd tʊ ɛndʒˈɔɪ sˈʌmθɪŋ/

lines.speaker: A
lines.text: The consultation asked users whether the new facilities looked accessible.
lines.ipa: /ðə kɒnsəltˈeɪʃən ˈaskt jˈuːzəz wˈɛðə ðə njˈuː fəsˈɪlɪtiz lˈʊkt aksˈɛsəbəl/

lines.speaker: B
lines.text: That's a difficult question to answer from a drawing.
lines.ipa: /ðats ɐ dˈɪfɪkəlt kwˈɛstʃən tʊ ˈansə fɹɒm ɐ dɹˈɔːɪŋ/

lines.speaker: A
lines.text: Exactly. We were being invited to approve something we couldn't actually try.
lines.ipa: /ɛɡzˈaktli wiː wɜː bˌiːɪŋ ɪnvˈaɪtɪd tʊ ɐpɹˈuːv sˈʌmθɪŋ wiː kˌʊdənt ˈaktʃuːəli tɹˈaɪ/

lines.speaker: B
lines.text: Ask for a practical test before the consultation is treated as confirmation.
lines.ipa: /ˈask fəɹə pɹˈaktɪkəl tˈɛst bɪfˌɔː ðə kɒnsəltˈeɪʃən ɪz tɹˈiːtɪd az kɒnfəmˈeɪʃən/

lines.speaker: A
lines.text: The rare book is available, but only while a member of staff supervises the room.
lines.ipa: /ðə ɹˈeə bˈʊk ɪz ɐvˈeɪləbəl bˌʌt ˈəʊnli wˌaɪl ɐ mˈɛmbəɹ ɒv stˈaf sˈuːpəvˌaɪzɪz ðə ɹˈuːm/

lines.speaker: B
lines.text: That makes access depend on staffing rather than the catalogue entry.
lines.ipa: /ðat mˌeɪks ˈaksɛs dɪpˈɛnd ˌɒn stˈafɪŋ ɹˈɑːðə ðɐn ðə kˈatɐlˌɒɡ ˈɛntɹi/

lines.speaker: A
lines.text: And the hours keep changing, so planning a visit is becoming a research project of its own.
lines.ipa: /and ðɪ ˈaʊəz kˈiːp tʃˈeɪndʒɪŋ sˌəʊ plˈanɪŋ ɐ vˈɪzɪt ɪz bɪkˈʌmɪŋ ɐ ɹɪsˈɜːtʃ pɹˈɒdʒɛkt ɒv ɪts ˈəʊn/

lines.speaker: B
lines.text: Ask whether they can confirm a slot rather than merely announce opening times.
lines.ipa: /ˈask wˈɛðə ðeɪ kan kənfˈɜːm ɐ slˈɒt ɹˈɑːðə ðɐn mˈiəli ɐnˈaʊns ˈəʊpənɪŋ tˈaɪmz/

lines.speaker: A
lines.text: I understood the assignment better after reading the tutor's explanation of a wrong answer.
lines.ipa: /aɪ ˌʌndəstˈʊd ðɪ ɐsˈaɪnmənt bˈɛtəɹ ˈaftə ɹˈiːdɪŋ ðə tjˈuːtəz ɛksplɐnˈeɪʃən əvə ɹˈɒŋ ˈansə/

lines.speaker: B
lines.text: Because it showed the boundary of the idea?
lines.ipa: /bɪkˈɒz ɪt ʃˈəʊd ðə bˈaʊndəɹi ɒvðɪ aɪdˈiə/

lines.speaker: A
lines.text: Yes. The polished model answer made the choice look obvious.
lines.ipa: /jˈɛs ðə pˈɒlɪʃt mˈɒdəl ˈansə mˌeɪd ðə tʃˈɔɪs lˈʊk ˈɒbviəs/

lines.speaker: B
lines.text: A useful mistake can reveal a decision that a perfect answer conceals.
lines.ipa: /ɐ jˈuːsfəl mɪstˈeɪk kan ɹɪvˈiːl ɐ dɪsˈɪʒən ðˌatə pˈɜːfɛkt ˈansə kənsˈiːlz/

lines.speaker: A
lines.text: Our study group became more useful when we stopped dividing the reading into equal page counts.
lines.ipa: /ˌaʊə stˈʌdi ɡɹˈuːp bɪkˌeɪm mˈɔː jˈuːsfəl wɛn wiː stˈɒpt dɪvˈaɪdɪŋ ðə ɹˈiːdɪŋ ˌɪntʊ ˈiːkwəl pˈeɪdʒ kˈaʊnts/

lines.speaker: B
lines.text: Were some sections much harder than others?
lines.ipa: /wɜː sˌʌm sˈɛkʃənz mˈʌtʃ hˈɑːdə ðɐn ˈʌðəz/

lines.speaker: A
lines.text: Exactly. Equal slices of paper weren't equal amounts of work.
lines.ipa: /ɛɡzˈaktli ˈiːkwəl slˈaɪsɪz ɒv pˈeɪpə wˌɜːnt ˈiːkwəl ɐmˈaʊnts ɒv wˈɜːk/

lines.speaker: B
lines.text: Assign the concepts, then review the workload once people have seen what they're taking on.
lines.ipa: /ɐsˈaɪn ðə kˈɒnsɛpts ðˈɛn ɹɪvjˈuː ðə wˈɜːkləʊd wˈʌns pˈiːpəl hav sˈiːn wɒt ðeɪə tˈeɪkɪŋ ˈɒn/

lines.speaker: A
lines.text: I requested an extension and then spent the extra time expanding the task.
lines.ipa: /aɪ ɹɪkwˈɛstɪd ɐn ɛkstˈɛnʃən and ðˈɛn spˈɛnt ðɪ ˈɛkstɹə tˈaɪm ɛkspˈandɪŋ ðə tˈask/

lines.speaker: B
lines.text: So the deadline moved, but the finish line moved with it.
lines.ipa: /sˌəʊ ðə dˈɛdlaɪn mˈuːvd bˌʌt ðə fˈɪnɪʃ lˈaɪn mˈuːvd wɪð ɪt/

lines.speaker: A
lines.text: I'm beginning to see why the extra week didn't help.
lines.ipa: /aɪm bɪɡˈɪnɪŋ tə sˈiː wˌaɪ ðɪ ˈɛkstɹə wˈiːk dˈɪdnt hˈɛlp/

lines.speaker: B
lines.text: Agree what finished means before you negotiate another date.
lines.ipa: /ɐɡɹˈiː wɒt fˈɪnɪʃt mˈiːnz bɪfˌɔː juː nɪɡˈəʊʃɪˌeɪt ɐnˈʌðə dˈeɪt/

lines.speaker: A
lines.text: The feedback was thoughtful, but I couldn't tell which suggestion mattered most.
lines.ipa: /ðə fˈiːdbak wɒz θˈɔːtfəl bˌʌt aɪ kˌʊdənt tˈɛl wˌɪtʃ sədʒˈɛstʃən mˈatəd mˈəʊst/

lines.speaker: B
lines.text: Did it distinguish a central weakness from optional improvements?
lines.ipa: /dˈɪd ɪt dɪstˈɪŋɡwɪʃ ɐ sˈɛntɹəl wˈiːknəs fɹɒm ˈɒpʃənəl ɪmpɹˈuːvmənts/

lines.speaker: A
lines.text: No. Every comment had the same reassuring tone.
lines.ipa: /nˈəʊ ˈɛvɹɪ kˈɒmɛnt had ðə sˈeɪm ɹˌiːəʃˈʊəɹɪŋ tˈəʊn/

lines.speaker: B
lines.text: Ask what one change would most improve the work. Priorities are part of useful feedback.
lines.ipa: /ˈask wɒt wˈɒn tʃˈeɪndʒ wʊd mˈəʊst ɪmpɹˈuːv ðə wˈɜːk pɹaɪˈɒɹɪtiz ɑː pˈɑːt ɒv jˈuːsfəl fˈiːdbak/

lines.speaker: A
lines.text: The course prospectus is wonderfully specific about facilities and vague about teaching.
lines.ipa: /ðə kˈɔːs pɹəspˈɛktəs ɪz wˈʌndəfəli spəsˈɪfɪk ɐbˌaʊt fəsˈɪlɪtiz and vˈeɪɡ ɐbˌaʊt tˈiːtʃɪŋ/

lines.speaker: B
lines.text: You're getting a detailed tour of everything except the education.
lines.ipa: /jɔː ɡˌɛtɪŋ ɐ dˈiːteɪld tˈʊəɹ ɒv ˈɛvɹɪθˌɪŋ ɛksˈɛpt ðɪ ˌɛdʒuːkˈeɪʃən/

lines.speaker: A
lines.text: Even the sample timetable lists room names instead of activities.
lines.ipa: /ˈiːvən ðə sˈampəl tˈaɪmteɪbəl lˈɪsts ɹˈuːm nˈeɪmz ɪnstˈɛd ɒv aktˈɪvɪtiz/

lines.speaker: B
lines.text: Request a sample task and the kind of feedback students receive on it.
lines.ipa: /ɹɪkwˈɛst ɐ sˈampəl tˈask and ðə kˈaɪnd ɒv fˈiːdbak stjˈuːdənts ɹɪsˈiːv ˈɒn ɪt/

lines.speaker: A
lines.text: I rehearsed the presentation until every sentence sounded inevitable.
lines.ipa: /aɪ ɹɪhˈɜːst ðə pɹˌɛzəntˈeɪʃən ʌntˈɪl ˈɛvɹɪ sˈɛntəns sˈaʊndɪd ɪnˈɛvɪtəbəl/

lines.speaker: B
lines.text: And then someone asked a sensible question?
lines.ipa: /and ðˈɛn sˈʌmwɒn ˈaskt ɐ sˈɛnsɪbəl kwˈɛstʃən/

lines.speaker: A
lines.text: I answered it, but couldn't find my way back to the memorised sentence.
lines.ipa: /aɪ ˈansəd ɪt bˌʌt kˌʊdənt fˈaɪnd maɪ wˈeɪ bˈak tə ðə mˈɛməɹˌaɪzd sˈɛntəns/

lines.speaker: B
lines.text: Build your return around the idea, not the exact wording you left behind.
lines.ipa: /bˈɪld jɔː ɹɪtˈɜːn ɐɹˈaʊnd ðɪ aɪdˈiə nˌɒt ðɪ ɛɡzˈakt wˈɜːdɪŋ juː lˈɛft bɪhˈaɪnd/

lines.speaker: A
lines.text: The online course advertises flexibility, though live attendance determines half the mark.
lines.ipa: /ðɪ ˈɒnlaɪn kˈɔːs ˈadvətˌaɪzɪz flˌɛksəbˈɪlɪti ðˌəʊ lˈaɪv ɐtˈɛndəns dɪtˈɜːmɪnz hˈɑːf ðə mˈɑːk/

lines.speaker: B
lines.text: Did they distinguish flexible access from flexible assessment?
lines.ipa: /dˈɪd ðeɪ dɪstˈɪŋɡwɪʃ flˈɛksɪbəl ˈaksɛs fɹɒm flˈɛksɪbəl ɐsˈɛsmənt/

lines.speaker: A
lines.text: Only after I asked.
lines.ipa: /ˈəʊnli ˈaftəɹ aɪ ˈaskt/

lines.speaker: B
lines.text: That distinction belongs in the description, before people arrange their lives around the promise.
lines.ipa: /ðat dɪstˈɪŋkʃən bɪlˈɒŋz ɪnðə dɪskɹˈɪpʃən bɪfˌɔː pˈiːpəl ɐɹˈeɪndʒ ðeə lˈaɪvz ɐɹˈaʊnd ðə pɹˈɒmɪs/

lines.speaker: A
lines.text: I found a quotation attributed to three different writers.
lines.ipa: /aɪ fˈaʊnd ɐ kwəʊtˈeɪʃən ɐtɹˈɪbjuːtɪd tə θɹˈiː dˈɪfɹənt ɹˈaɪtəz/

lines.speaker: B
lines.text: Which version did you use?
lines.ipa: /wˌɪtʃ vˈɜːʃən dˈɪd juː jˈuːz/

lines.speaker: A
lines.text: None. The wording shifts each time, and nobody gives a publication.
lines.ipa: /nˈɒn ðə wˈɜːdɪŋ ʃˈɪfts ˈiːtʃ tˈaɪm and nˈəʊbɒdi ɡˈɪvz ɐ pˌʌblɪkˈeɪʃən/

lines.speaker: B
lines.text: Leaving it out is better than decorating the essay with borrowed authority you can't establish.
lines.ipa: /lˈiːvɪŋ ɪt ˈaʊt ɪz bˈɛtə ðɐn dˈɛkəɹˌeɪtɪŋ ðɪ ˈɛseɪ wɪð bˈɒɹəʊd ɐθˈɒɹɪti juː kˈɑːnt ɪstˈablɪʃ/

lines.speaker: A
lines.text: I'm revising more slowly now that I'm checking whether I can explain each idea.
lines.ipa: /aɪm ɹɪvˈaɪzɪŋ mˈɔː slˈəʊli nˈaʊ ðat aɪm tʃˈɛkɪŋ wˈɛðəɹ aɪ kan ɛksplˈeɪn ˈiːtʃ aɪdˈiə/

lines.speaker: B
lines.text: Does that feel like going backwards?
lines.ipa: /dˈʌz ðat fˈiːl lˈaɪk ɡˌəʊɪŋ bˈakwədz/

lines.speaker: A
lines.text: A little. The number of pages covered looks unimpressive.
lines.ipa: /ɐ lˈɪtəl ðə nˈʌmbəɹ ɒv pˈeɪdʒɪz kˈʌvəd lˈʊks ˌʌnɪmpɹˈɛsɪv/

lines.speaker: B
lines.text: You've changed the measure from exposure to understanding. The old count won't capture the new work.
lines.ipa: /juːv tʃˈeɪndʒd ðə mˈɛʒə fɹɒm ɛkspˈəʊʒə tʊ ˌʌndəstˈandɪŋ ðɪ ˈəʊld kˈaʊnt wəʊnt kˈaptʃə ðə njˈuː wˈɜːk/

lines.speaker: A
lines.text: The meeting was perfectly organised and still had no obvious reason to happen.
lines.ipa: /ðə mˈiːtɪŋ wɒz pˈɜːfɛktlˌɪ ˈɔːɡɐnˌaɪzd and stˈɪl had nˈəʊ ˈɒbviəs ɹˈiːzən tə hˈapən/

lines.speaker: B
lines.text: Did the agenda identify a decision or just a sequence of updates?
lines.ipa: /dˈɪd ðɪ ɐdʒˈɛndəɹ aɪdˈɛntɪfˌaɪ ɐ dɪsˈɪʒən ɔː dʒˈʌst ɐ sˈiːkwəns ɒv ˈʌpdeɪts/

lines.speaker: A
lines.text: A very tidy sequence of updates.
lines.ipa: /ɐ vˈɛɹi tˈaɪdi sˈiːkwəns ɒv ˈʌpdeɪts/

lines.speaker: B
lines.text: Then ask what would be lost if the same information were circulated in writing.
lines.ipa: /ðˈɛn ˈask wɒt wʊd biː lˈɒst ɪf ðə sˈeɪm ˌɪnfəmˈeɪʃən wɜː sˈɜːkjʊlˌeɪtɪd ɪn ɹˈaɪtɪŋ/

lines.speaker: A
lines.text: I offered to help and somehow became responsible for coordinating everyone else's help.
lines.ipa: /aɪ ˈɒfəd tə hˈɛlp and sˈʌmhaʊ bɪkˌeɪm ɹɪspˈɒnsɪbəl fɔː kəʊˈɔːdɪnˌeɪtɪŋ ˈɛvɹɪwˌɒn ˈɛlsɪz hˈɛlp/

lines.speaker: B
lines.text: The invisible promotion nobody remembers agreeing to.
lines.ipa: /ðɪ ɪnvˈɪzɪbəl pɹəmˈəʊʃən nˈəʊbɒdi ɹɪmˈɛmbəz ɐɡɹˈiːɪŋ tuː/

lines.speaker: A
lines.text: Exactly. I'm not unwilling; I just need it recognised in the workload.
lines.ipa: /ɛɡzˈaktli aɪm nˌɒt ʌnwˈɪlɪŋ aɪ dʒˈʌst nˈiːd ɪt ɹˈɛkəɡnˌaɪzd ɪnðə wˈɜːkləʊd/

lines.speaker: B
lines.text: Name the coordinating task explicitly before accepting another small favour.
lines.ipa: /nˈeɪm ðə kəʊˈɔːdɪnˌeɪtɪŋ tˈask ɛksplˈɪsɪtli bɪfˌɔːɹ ɐksˈɛptɪŋ ɐnˈʌðə smˈɔːl fˈeɪvə/

lines.speaker: A
lines.text: The office return improved informal contact but made focused work harder.
lines.ipa: /ðɪ ˈɒfɪs ɹɪtˈɜːn ɪmpɹˈuːvd ɪnfˈɔːməl kˈɒntakt bˌʌt mˌeɪd fˈəʊkəst wˈɜːk hˈɑːdə/

lines.speaker: B
lines.text: So neither side of the debate gets a clean victory.
lines.ipa: /sˌəʊ nˈaɪðə sˈaɪd ɒvðə dɪbˈeɪt ɡˈɛts ɐ klˈiːn vˈɪktəɹi/

lines.speaker: A
lines.text: Right. We keep being asked to choose which location is better overall.
lines.ipa: /ɹˈaɪt wiː kˈiːp bˌiːɪŋ ˈaskt tə tʃˈuːz wˌɪtʃ ləʊkˈeɪʃən ɪz bˈɛtəɹ ˌəʊvəɹˈɔːl/

lines.speaker: B
lines.text: Describe which activities benefit from each setting. A single answer may be the wrong goal.
lines.ipa: /dɪskɹˈaɪb wˌɪtʃ aktˈɪvɪtiz bˈɛnɪfˌɪt fɹɒm ˈiːtʃ sˈɛtɪŋ ɐ sˈɪŋɡəl ˈansə mˈeɪ biː ðə ɹˈɒŋ ɡˈəʊl/

lines.speaker: A
lines.text: The procedure works if you already know which exceptions to ignore.
lines.ipa: /ðə pɹəsˈiːdʒə wˈɜːks ɪf juː ɔːlɹˌɛdi nˈəʊ wˌɪtʃ ɛksˈɛpʃənz tʊ ɪɡnˈɔː/

lines.speaker: B
lines.text: That isn't much of a procedure for a newcomer.
lines.ipa: /ðat ˌɪzənt mˈʌtʃ əvə pɹəsˈiːdʒə fəɹə njˈuːkʌmə/

lines.speaker: A
lines.text: The experienced staff say it's common sense.
lines.ipa: /ðɪ ɛkspˈiəɹɪənst stˈaf sˈeɪ ɪts kˈɒmən sˈɛns/

lines.speaker: B
lines.text: Ask them to explain one awkward case. That's often where the unwritten rules become visible.
lines.ipa: /ˈask ðˌɛm tʊ ɛksplˈeɪn wˈɒn ˈɔːkwəd kˈeɪs ðats ˈɒfən wˌeə ðɪ ʌnɹˈɪtən ɹˈuːlz bɪkˌʌm vˈɪzɪbəl/

lines.speaker: A
lines.text: The client accepted the delay because we explained what the original estimate had missed.
lines.ipa: /ðə klˈaɪənt ɐksˈɛptɪd ðə dɪlˈeɪ bɪkˈɒz wiː ɛksplˈeɪnd wɒt ðɪ əɹˈɪdʒɪnəl ˈɛstɪmət had mˈɪst/

lines.speaker: B
lines.text: Did you have to defend the estimate as well?
lines.ipa: /dˈɪd juː hav tə dɪfˈɛnd ðɪ ˈɛstɪmət az wˈɛl/

lines.speaker: A
lines.text: We acknowledged the error instead. It made the rest of the discussion considerably easier.
lines.ipa: /wiː ɐknˈɒlɪdʒd ðɪ ˈɛɹəɹ ɪnstˈɛd ɪt mˌeɪd ðə ɹˈɛst ɒvðə dɪskˈʌʃən kənsˈɪdəɹəbli ˈiːziə/

lines.speaker: B
lines.text: An explanation doesn't have to become an excuse.
lines.ipa: /ɐn ɛksplɐnˈeɪʃən dˈʌzənt hav tə bɪkˌʌm ɐn ɛkskjˈuːs/

lines.speaker: A
lines.text: Our new colleague spotted a risk we'd all learned to work around.
lines.ipa: /ˌaʊə njˈuː kˈɒliːɡ spˈɒtɪd ɐ ɹˈɪsk wiːd ˈɔːl lˈɜːnd tə wˈɜːk ɐɹˈaʊnd/

lines.speaker: B
lines.text: Were people pleased to have it pointed out?
lines.ipa: /wɜː pˈiːpəl plˈiːzd tə hav ɪt pˈɔɪntɪd ˈaʊt/

lines.speaker: A
lines.text: Eventually. First we explained at length why it wasn't really a problem.
lines.ipa: /ɪvˈɛntʃuːəli fˈɜːst wiː ɛksplˈeɪnd at lˈɛŋθ wˌaɪ ɪt wˌɒzn̩t ɹˈiəlɪ ɐ pɹˈɒbləm/

lines.speaker: B
lines.text: Familiarity can make an inconvenience look more reasonable than it is.
lines.ipa: /fəmˌɪliˈaɹɪti kan mˌeɪk ɐn ɪŋkənvˈiːnɪəns lˈʊk mˈɔː ɹˈiːzənəbəl ðɐn ɪt ˈɪz/

lines.speaker: A
lines.text: I described the disagreement as a communication problem because I wanted to keep it polite.
lines.ipa: /aɪ dɪskɹˈaɪbd ðə dˌɪsɐɡɹˈiːmənt az ɐ kəmjˌuːnɪkˈeɪʃən pɹˈɒbləm bɪkˈɒz aɪ wˈɒntɪd tə kˈiːp ɪt pəlˈaɪt/

lines.speaker: B
lines.text: But you actually understood each other and wanted different things?
lines.ipa: /bˌʌt juː ˈaktʃuːəli ˌʌndəstˈʊd ˈiːtʃ ˈʌðə and wˈɒntɪd dˈɪfɹənt θˈɪŋz/

lines.speaker: A
lines.text: Precisely. No amount of clearer wording was going to remove that.
lines.ipa: /pɹɪsˈaɪsli nˈəʊ ɐmˈaʊnt ɒv klˈiəɹə wˈɜːdɪŋ wɒz ɡˌəʊɪŋ tə ɹɪmˈuːv ðˈat/

lines.speaker: B
lines.text: Then negotiating the difference may be more honest than diagnosing the conversation.
lines.ipa: /ðˈɛn nɪɡˈəʊʃɪˌeɪtɪŋ ðə dˈɪfɹəns mˈeɪ biː mˈɔːɹ ˈɒnɪst ðɐn dˌaɪəɡnˈəʊzɪŋ ðə kɒnvəsˈeɪʃən/

lines.speaker: A
lines.text: The report is comprehensive, yet I can't find the recommendation.
lines.ipa: /ðə ɹɪpˈɔːt ɪz kˌɒmpɹɪhˈɛnsɪv jˈɛt aɪ kˈɑːnt fˈaɪnd ðə ɹˌɛkəmɛndˈeɪʃən/

lines.speaker: B
lines.text: Perhaps it's being cautious about appearing too opinionated.
lines.ipa: /pəhˈaps ɪts bˌiːɪŋ kˈɔːʃəs ɐbˌaʊt ɐpˈiəɹɪŋ tˈuː əpˈɪniənˌeɪtɪd/

lines.speaker: A
lines.text: It was commissioned to recommend something.
lines.ipa: /ɪt wɒz kəmˈɪʃənd tə ɹˌɛkəmˈɛnd sˈʌmθɪŋ/

lines.speaker: B
lines.text: Then the caution is obstructing the purpose. The evidence can support a clear judgement without pretending certainty.
lines.ipa: /ðˈɛn ðə kˈɔːʃən ɪz ɒbstɹˈʌktɪŋ ðə pˈɜːpəs ðɪ ˈɛvɪdəns kan səpˈɔːt ɐ klˈiə dʒˈʌdʒmənt wɪðˌaʊt pɹɪtˈɛndɪŋ sˈɜːtənti/

lines.speaker: A
lines.text: The pilot saved time in our team by passing several checks to another department.
lines.ipa: /ðə pˈaɪlət sˈeɪvd tˈaɪm ɪn ˌaʊə tˈiːm baɪ pˈasɪŋ sˈɛvɹəl tʃˈɛks tʊ ɐnˈʌðə dɪpˈɑːtmənt/

lines.speaker: B
lines.text: Did the evaluation count their extra work?
lines.ipa: /dˈɪd ðɪ ɪvˌaljuːˈeɪʃən kˈaʊnt ðeəɹ ˈɛkstɹə wˈɜːk/

lines.speaker: A
lines.text: Only ours. The improvement looked rather dramatic.
lines.ipa: /ˈəʊnli aʊəz ðɪ ɪmpɹˈuːvmənt lˈʊkt ɹˈɑːðə dɹəmˈatɪk/

lines.speaker: B
lines.text: Widen the measurement before calling it a saving.
lines.ipa: /wˈaɪdən ðə mˈɛʒəmənt bɪfˌɔː kˈɔːlɪŋ ɪt ɐ sˈeɪvɪŋ/

lines.speaker: A
lines.text: The handover document records every action but none of the rejected alternatives.
lines.ipa: /ðə hˈandəʊvə dˈɒkjuːmənt ɹˈɛkɔːdz ˈɛvɹɪ ˈakʃən bˌʌt nˈɒn ɒvðə ɹɪdʒˈɛktɪd ɔːltˈɜːnətˌɪvz/

lines.speaker: B
lines.text: So the next person is likely to rediscover the same dead ends.
lines.ipa: /sˌəʊ ðə nˈɛkst pˈɜːsən ɪz lˈaɪkli tə ɹˌiːdɪskˈʌvə ðə sˈeɪm dˈɛd ˈɛndz/

lines.speaker: A
lines.text: That's what happened when I took over.
lines.ipa: /ðats wɒt hˈapənd wɛn aɪ tˈʊk ˈəʊvə/

lines.speaker: B
lines.text: Add the reasoning while it's still available. A decision's history can prevent its accidental reversal.
lines.ipa: /ˈad ðə ɹˈiːzənɪŋ wˌaɪl ɪts stˈɪl ɐvˈeɪləbəl ɐ dɪsˈɪʒənz hˈɪstəɹi kan pɹɪvˈɛnt ɪts ˌaksɪdˈɛntəl ɹɪvˈɜːsəl/

lines.speaker: A
lines.text: The password policy produces complex passwords and a remarkable collection of sticky notes.
lines.ipa: /ðə pˈaswɜːd pˈɒlɪsi pɹədjˈuːsɪz kˈɒmplɛks pˈaswɜːdz and ɐ ɹɪmˈɑːkəbəl kəlˈɛkʃən ɒv stˈɪki nˈəʊts/

lines.speaker: B
lines.text: People are finding a way to comply without being locked out.
lines.ipa: /pˈiːpəl ɑː fˈaɪndɪŋ ɐ wˈeɪ tə kəmplˈaɪ wɪðˌaʊt bˌiːɪŋ lˈɒkt ˈaʊt/

lines.speaker: A
lines.text: Exactly. The visible compliance is concealing the practical weakness.
lines.ipa: /ɛɡzˈaktli ðə vˈɪzɪbəl kəmplˈaɪəns ɪz kənsˈiːlɪŋ ðə pɹˈaktɪkəl wˈiːknəs/

lines.speaker: B
lines.text: We should examine the usable alternatives rather than simply demand more complicated behaviour.
lines.ipa: /wiː ʃˌʊd ɛɡzˈamɪn ðə jˈuːzəbəl ɔːltˈɜːnətˌɪvz ɹˈɑːðə ðɐn sˈɪmpli dɪmˈand mˈɔː kˈɒmplɪkˌeɪtɪd bɪhˈeɪvjə/

lines.speaker: A
lines.text: The document has so many sharing exceptions that nobody can explain who can read it.
lines.ipa: /ðə dˈɒkjuːmənt hɐz sˌəʊ mˈɛni ʃˈeəɹɪŋ ɛksˈɛpʃənz ðat nˈəʊbɒdi kan ɛksplˈeɪn hˌuː kan ɹˈiːd ɪt/

lines.speaker: B
lines.text: Were permissions added to solve individual requests?
lines.ipa: /wɜː pəmˈɪʃənz ˈadɪd tə sˈɒlv ˌɪndɪvˈɪdʒuːəl ɹɪkwˈɛsts/

lines.speaker: A
lines.text: One at a time, over several years.
lines.ipa: /wˈɒn atə tˈaɪm ˌəʊvə sˈɛvɹəl jˈiəz/

lines.speaker: B
lines.text: Start by agreeing the intended audience. Otherwise you're preserving a history of accidents.
lines.ipa: /stˈɑːt baɪ ɐɡɹˈiːɪŋ ðɪ ɪntˈɛndɪd ˈɔːdiəns ˈʌðəwˌaɪz jɔː pɹɪzˈɜːvɪŋ ɐ hˈɪstəɹi ɒv ˈaksɪdənts/

lines.speaker: A
lines.text: Our backup demonstration went smoothly because someone chose the easiest file to recover.
lines.ipa: /ˌaʊə bˈakʌp dˌɛmənstɹˈeɪʃən wɛnt smˈuːðli bɪkˈɒz sˈʌmwɒn tʃˈəʊz ðɪ ˈiːziɪst fˈaɪl tə ɹɪkˈʌvə/

lines.speaker: B
lines.text: Was it meant to prove the system worked or find where it failed?
lines.ipa: /wɒz ɪt mˈɛnt tə pɹˈuːv ðə sˈɪstəm wˈɜːkt ɔː fˈaɪnd wˌeəɹ ɪt fˈeɪld/

lines.speaker: A
lines.text: Officially the second; emotionally, I suspect, the first.
lines.ipa: /əfˈɪʃəli ðə sˈɛkənd ɪmˈəʊʃənəli aɪ səspˈɛkt ðə fˈɜːst/

lines.speaker: B
lines.text: Choose the test cases before anyone knows which outcome will be reassuring.
lines.ipa: /tʃˈuːz ðə tˈɛst kˈeɪsɪz bɪfˌɔːɹ ˈɛnɪwˌɒn nˈəʊz wˌɪtʃ ˈaʊtkʌm wɪl biː ɹˌiːəʃˈʊəɹɪŋ/

lines.speaker: A
lines.text: The notification settings offer control in principle and exhaustion in practice.
lines.ipa: /ðə nˌəʊtɪfɪkˈeɪʃən sˈɛtɪŋz ˈɒfə kəntɹˈəʊl ɪn pɹˈɪnsɪpəl and ɛɡzˈɔːstʃən ɪn pɹˈaktɪs/

lines.speaker: B
lines.text: Too many separate choices?
lines.ipa: /tˈuː mɛni sˈɛpɹət tʃˈɔɪsɪz/

lines.speaker: A
lines.text: And no way to understand which ones overlap.
lines.ipa: /and nˈəʊ wˈeɪ tʊ ˌʌndəstˈand wˌɪtʃ wˈɒnz ˌəʊvəlˈap/

lines.speaker: B
lines.text: Good control should let people predict the result, not just provide an impressive number of switches.
lines.ipa: /ɡˈʊd kəntɹˈəʊl ʃˌʊd lˈɛt pˈiːpəl pɹɪdˈɪkt ðə ɹɪzˈʌlt nˌɒt dʒˈʌst pɹəvˈaɪd ɐn ɪmpɹˈɛsɪv nˈʌmbəɹ ɒv swˈɪtʃɪz/

lines.speaker: A
lines.text: The update notice said the interface had been simplified.
lines.ipa: /ðɪ ˈʌpdeɪt nˈəʊtɪs sˈɛd ðɪ ˈɪntəfˌeɪs hɐdbɪn sˈɪmplɪfˌaɪd/

lines.speaker: B
lines.text: Which usually means I have to learn where the familiar things went.
lines.ipa: /wˌɪtʃ jˈuːʒuːəli mˈiːnz aɪ hav tə lˈɜːn wˌeə ðə fəmˈɪliə θˈɪŋz wˈɛnt/

lines.speaker: A
lines.text: In this case, two useful controls were combined under a label that describes neither.
lines.ipa: /ɪn ðɪs kˈeɪs tˈuː jˈuːsfəl kəntɹˈəʊlz wɜː kəmbˈaɪnd ˌʌndəɹ ɐ lˈeɪbəl ðat dɪskɹˈaɪbz nˈaɪðə/

lines.speaker: B
lines.text: Send that specific example. General dislike of change is easier to dismiss.
lines.ipa: /sˈɛnd ðat spəsˈɪfɪk ɛɡzˈampəl dʒˈɛnəɹəl dɪslˈaɪk ɒv tʃˈeɪndʒ ɪz ˈiːziə tə dɪsmˈɪs/

lines.speaker: A
lines.text: The connection problem was finally fixed when support stopped treating each failure as a new incident.
lines.ipa: /ðə kənˈɛkʃən pɹˈɒbləm wɒz fˈaɪnəli fˈɪkst wɛn səpˈɔːt stˈɒpt tɹˈiːtɪŋ ˈiːtʃ fˈeɪliəɹ az ɐ njˈuː ˈɪnsɪdənt/

lines.speaker: B
lines.text: They recognised a pattern across the tickets?
lines.ipa: /ðeɪ ɹˈɛkəɡnˌaɪzd ɐ pˈatən əkɹˌɒs ðə tˈɪkɪts/

lines.speaker: A
lines.text: Yes. The information was there, but scattered across separate cases.
lines.ipa: /jˈɛs ðɪ ˌɪnfəmˈeɪʃən wɒz ðˈeə bˌʌt skˈatəd əkɹˌɒs sˈɛpɹət kˈeɪsɪz/

lines.speaker: B
lines.text: Sometimes the missing tool is a joined-up account of what already happened.
lines.ipa: /sˈʌmtaɪmz ðə mˈɪsɪŋ tˈuːl ɪz ɐ dʒˈɔɪndˌʌp ɐkˈaʊnt ɒv wɒt ɔːlɹˌɛdi hˈapənd/

lines.speaker: A
lines.text: The privacy summary says the service doesn't sell personal information.
lines.ipa: /ðə pɹˈɪvəsi sˈʌməɹi sˈɛz ðə sˈɜːvɪs dˈʌzənt sˈɛl pˈɜːsənəl ˌɪnfəmˈeɪʃən/

lines.speaker: B
lines.text: Does it say whether it shares it for other purposes?
lines.ipa: /dˈʌz ɪt sˈeɪ wˈɛðəɹ ɪt ʃˈeəz ɪt fɔːɹ ˈʌðə pˈɜːpəsɪz/

lines.speaker: A
lines.text: That requires several more pages and a different definition of sharing.
lines.ipa: /ðat ɹɪkwˈaɪəz sˈɛvɹəl mˈɔː pˈeɪdʒɪz and ɐ dˈɪfɹənt dˌɛfɪnˈɪʃən ɒv ʃˈeəɹɪŋ/

lines.speaker: B
lines.text: The reassuring sentence may be accurate without answering the question you actually care about.
lines.ipa: /ðə ɹˌiːəʃˈʊəɹɪŋ sˈɛntəns mˈeɪ biː ˈakjʊɹət wɪðˌaʊt ˈansəɹɪŋ ðə kwˈɛstʃən juː ˈaktʃuːəli kˈeəɹ ɐbˈaʊt/

lines.speaker: A
lines.text: The accessibility audit passed, but our colleague still can't complete a booking independently.
lines.ipa: /ðɪ aksˌɛsəbˈɪlɪti ˈɔːdɪt pˈast bˌʌt ˌaʊə kˈɒliːɡ stˈɪl kˈɑːnt kəmplˈiːt ɐ bˈʊkɪŋ ˌɪndɪpˈɛndəntli/

lines.speaker: B
lines.text: Did the audit test the actual booking process?
lines.ipa: /dˈɪd ðɪ ˈɔːdɪt tˈɛst ðɪ ˈaktʃuːəl bˈʊkɪŋ pɹˈəʊsɛs/

lines.speaker: A
lines.text: It tested the components separately.
lines.ipa: /ɪt tˈɛstɪd ðə kəmpˈəʊnənts sˈɛpɹətli/

lines.speaker: B
lines.text: A working collection of parts doesn't guarantee a usable route through them.
lines.ipa: /ɐ wˈɜːkɪŋ kəlˈɛkʃən ɒv pˈɑːts dˈʌzənt ɡˌaɹəntˈiː ɐ jˈuːzəbəl ɹˈuːt θɹˈuː ðˌɛm/

lines.speaker: A
lines.text: The writing tool makes uncertain drafts sound impressively settled.
lines.ipa: /ðə ɹˈaɪtɪŋ tˈuːl mˌeɪks ʌnsˈɜːtən dɹˈafts sˈaʊnd ɪmpɹˈɛsɪvli sˈɛtəld/

lines.speaker: B
lines.text: Is the content becoming more reliable or merely more fluent?
lines.ipa: /ɪz ðə kˈɒntɛnt bɪkˈʌmɪŋ mˈɔː ɹɪlˈaɪəbəl ɔː mˈiəli mˈɔː flˈuːənt/

lines.speaker: A
lines.text: Often just more fluent, which makes the gaps harder to notice.
lines.ipa: /ˈɒfən dʒˈʌst mˈɔː flˈuːənt wˌɪtʃ mˌeɪks ðə ɡˈaps hˈɑːdə tə nˈəʊtɪs/

lines.speaker: B
lines.text: Keep the uncertainty visible until the supporting work has actually been done.
lines.ipa: /kˈiːp ðɪ ʌnsˈɜːtənti vˈɪzɪbəl ʌntˈɪl ðə səpˈɔːtɪŋ wˈɜːk hɐz ˈaktʃuːəli bˌiːn dˈʌn/

lines.speaker: A
lines.text: The cancellation survey offered every reason except no longer needed.
lines.ipa: /ðə kˌansɪlˈeɪʃən sˈɜːveɪ ˈɒfəd ˈɛvɹɪ ɹˈiːzən ɛksˈɛpt nˌəʊ lˈɒŋɡə nˈiːdɪd/

lines.speaker: B
lines.text: So leaving had to be classified as something going wrong.
lines.ipa: /sˌəʊ lˈiːvɪŋ hadtə biː klˈasɪfˌaɪd az sˈʌmθɪŋ ɡˌəʊɪŋ ɹˈɒŋ/

lines.speaker: A
lines.text: I selected other and was invited to explain my disappointment.
lines.ipa: /aɪ sɪlˈɛktɪd ˈʌðə and wɒz ɪnvˈaɪtɪd tʊ ɛksplˈeɪn maɪ dˌɪsɐpˈɔɪntmənt/

lines.speaker: B
lines.text: A service can be perfectly adequate and still no longer belong in someone's life.
lines.ipa: /ɐ sˈɜːvɪs kan biː pˈɜːfɛktlˌɪ ˈadɪkwət and stˈɪl nˌəʊ lˈɒŋɡə bɪlˈɒŋ ɪn sˈʌmwɒnz lˈaɪf/

lines.speaker: A
lines.text: The recycling campaign congratulates residents, but the collection system rejects several items it promotes.
lines.ipa: /ðə ɹɪsˈaɪklɪŋ kampˈeɪn kəŋɡɹˈatʃʊlˌeɪts ɹˈɛzɪdənts bˌʌt ðə kəlˈɛkʃən sˈɪstəm ɹɪdʒˈɛkts sˈɛvɹəl ˈaɪtəmz ɪt pɹəmˈəʊts/

lines.speaker: B
lines.text: Have the campaign and the collection contractor compared their lists?
lines.ipa: /hav ðə kampˈeɪn and ðə kəlˈɛkʃən kəntɹˈaktə kəmpˈeəd ðeə lˈɪsts/

lines.speaker: A
lines.text: Apparently they approved different versions.
lines.ipa: /ɐpˈaɹəntli ðeɪ ɐpɹˈuːvd dˈɪfɹənt vˈɜːʃənz/

lines.speaker: B
lines.text: The public can't be expected to reconcile instructions the organisations haven't reconciled themselves.
lines.ipa: /ðə pˈʌblɪk kˈɑːnt biː ɛkspˈɛktɪd tə ɹˈɛkənsˌaɪl ɪnstɹˈʌkʃənz ðɪ ˌɔːɡɐnaɪzˈeɪʃənz hˈavənt ɹˈɛkənsˌaɪld ðɛmsˈɛlvz/

lines.speaker: A
lines.text: The water-saving scheme reports the same percentage reduction every season.
lines.ipa: /ðə wˈɔːtəsˈeɪvɪŋ skˈiːm ɹɪpˈɔːts ðə sˈeɪm pəsˈɛntɪdʒ ɹɪdˈʌkʃən ˈɛvɹɪ sˈiːzən/

lines.speaker: B
lines.text: Is that measured against comparable conditions?
lines.ipa: /ɪz ðat mˈɛʒəd ɐɡˈɛnst kˈɒmpəɹəbəl kəndˈɪʃənz/

lines.speaker: A
lines.text: The baseline was an unusually dry month.
lines.ipa: /ðə bˈeɪslaɪn wɒz ɐn ʌnjˈuːʒuːəli dɹˈaɪ mˈʌnθ/

lines.speaker: B
lines.text: Then the percentage needs its context before it becomes evidence of a consistent result.
lines.ipa: /ðˈɛn ðə pəsˈɛntɪdʒ nˈiːdz ɪts kˈɒntɛkst bɪfˌɔːɹ ɪt bɪkˌʌmz ˈɛvɪdəns əvə kənsˈɪstənt ɹɪzˈʌlt/

lines.speaker: A
lines.text: The tree-planting proposal gained support after the organisers showed how the site would look in twenty years.
lines.ipa: /ðə tɹˈiːplˈantɪŋ pɹəpˈəʊzəl ɡˈeɪnd səpˈɔːt ˈaftə ðɪ ˈɔːɡɐnˌaɪzəz ʃˈəʊd hˌaʊ ðə sˈaɪt wʊd lˈʊk ɪn twˈɛnti jˈiəz/

lines.speaker: B
lines.text: Did they also explain who would maintain it until then?
lines.ipa: /dˈɪd ðeɪ ˈɔːlsəʊ ɛksplˈeɪn hˌuː wʊd meɪntˈeɪn ɪt ʌntˈɪl ðˈɛn/

lines.speaker: A
lines.text: That question was noticeably less popular than the drawings.
lines.ipa: /ðat kwˈɛstʃən wɒz nˈəʊtɪsəbli lˈɛs pˈɒpjʊlə ðɐn ðə dɹˈɔːɪŋz/

lines.speaker: B
lines.text: A long-term vision still has to pass through a series of ordinary summers.
lines.ipa: /ɐ lˈɒŋtˈɜːm vˈɪʒən stˈɪl hɐz tə pˈas θɹuː ɐ sˈiəɹiz ɒv ˈɔːdɪnəɹi sˈʌməz/

lines.speaker: A
lines.text: The cleanup photographs make the volunteers visible and the maintenance staff invisible.
lines.ipa: /ðə klˈiːnʌp fˈəʊtəɡɹˌafz mˌeɪk ðə vˌɒləntˈiəz vˈɪzɪbəl and ðə mˈeɪntənəns stˈaf ɪnvˈɪzɪbəl/

lines.speaker: B
lines.text: Even though the staff collect everything afterwards?
lines.ipa: /ˈiːvən ðˌəʊ ðə stˈaf kəlˈɛkt ˈɛvɹɪθˌɪŋ ˈaftəwədz/

lines.speaker: A
lines.text: And keep the park usable between events.
lines.ipa: /and kˈiːp ðə pˈɑːk jˈuːzəbəl bɪtwˌiːn ɪvˈɛnts/

lines.speaker: B
lines.text: The publicity could acknowledge the ongoing work without diminishing the volunteers' contribution.
lines.ipa: /ðə pʌblˈɪsɪti kʊd ɐknˈɒlɪdʒ ðɪ ˈɒŋɡəʊɪŋ wˈɜːk wɪðˌaʊt dɪmˈɪnɪʃɪŋ ðə vˌɒləntˈiəz kˌɒntɹɪbjˈuːʃən/

lines.speaker: A
lines.text: The market was designed to support local businesses, but its most expensive stalls now go to visiting chains.
lines.ipa: /ðə mˈɑːkɪt wɒz dɪzˈaɪnd tə səpˈɔːt lˈəʊkəl bˈɪznəsɪz bˌʌt ɪts mˈəʊst ɛkspˈɛnsɪv stˈɔːlz nˈaʊ ɡˌəʊ tə vˈɪzɪtɪŋ tʃˈeɪnz/

lines.speaker: B
lines.text: Do those stalls subsidise the smaller sellers?
lines.ipa: /dˈuː ðəʊz stˈɔːlz sˈʌbsɪdˌaɪz ðə smˈɔːlə sˈɛləz/

lines.speaker: A
lines.text: That's the explanation, though nobody has shown the figures.
lines.ipa: /ðats ðɪ ɛksplɐnˈeɪʃən ðˌəʊ nˈəʊbɒdi hɐz ʃˈəʊn ðə fˈɪɡəz/

lines.speaker: B
lines.text: Ask whether the arrangement is delivering the benefit used to justify it.
lines.ipa: /ˈask wˈɛðə ðɪ ɐɹˈeɪndʒmənt ɪz dɪlˈɪvəɹɪŋ ðə bˈɛnɪfˌɪt jˈuːzd tə dʒˈʌstɪfˌaɪ ɪt/

lines.speaker: A
lines.text: The sharing library is proud of how many items it lends, but not all returns are recorded.
lines.ipa: /ðə ʃˈeəɹɪŋ lˈaɪbɹəɹi ɪz pɹˈaʊd ɒv hˌaʊ mˈɛni ˈaɪtəmz ɪt lˈɛndz bˌʌt nˌɒt ˈɔːl ɹɪtˈɜːnz ɑː ɹɪkˈɔːdɪd/

lines.speaker: B
lines.text: Then the impressive activity may be masking a shrinking stock.
lines.ipa: /ðˈɛn ðɪ ɪmpɹˈɛsɪv aktˈɪvɪti mˈeɪ biː mˈaskɪŋ ɐ ʃɹˈɪŋkɪŋ stˈɒk/

lines.speaker: A
lines.text: We won't know until someone does an inventory.
lines.ipa: /wiː wəʊnt nˈəʊ ʌntˈɪl sˈʌmwɒn dˈʌz ɐn ˈɪnvəntɹi/

lines.speaker: B
lines.text: Count what remains usable as well as what has passed through the door.
lines.ipa: /kˈaʊnt wɒt ɹɪmˈeɪnz jˈuːzəbəl az wˈɛl az wɒt hɐz pˈast θɹuː ðə dˈɔː/

lines.speaker: A
lines.text: Our plastic reduction target was met by switching to a heavier material.
lines.ipa: /ˌaʊə plˈastɪk ɹɪdˈʌkʃən tˈɑːɡɪt wɒz mˈɛt baɪ swˈɪtʃɪŋ tʊ ɐ hˈɛviə mətˈiəɹiəl/

lines.speaker: B
lines.text: Has the overall impact been assessed?
lines.ipa: /hɐz ðɪ ˌəʊvəɹˈɔːl ˈɪmpakt bˌiːn ɐsˈɛst/

lines.speaker: A
lines.text: Only the weight of plastic was counted.
lines.ipa: /ˈəʊnli ðə wˈeɪt ɒv plˈastɪk wɒz kˈaʊntɪd/

lines.speaker: B
lines.text: The target may have been achieved more successfully than the underlying purpose.
lines.ipa: /ðə tˈɑːɡɪt mˌeɪhɐv bˌiːn ɐtʃˈiːvd mˈɔː səksˈɛsfəli ðɐn ðɪ ˌʌndəlˈaɪɪŋ pˈɜːpəs/

lines.speaker: A
lines.text: The proposed cycle route is direct on the map and interrupted at every difficult junction.
lines.ipa: /ðə pɹəpˈəʊzd sˈaɪkəl ɹˈuːt ɪz daɪɹˈɛkt ɒnðə mˈap and ˌɪntəɹˈʌptɪd at ˈɛvɹɪ dˈɪfɪkəlt dʒˈʌŋkʃən/

lines.speaker: B
lines.text: So the straight line is doing more work than the actual infrastructure.
lines.ipa: /sˌəʊ ðə stɹˈeɪt lˈaɪn ɪz dˌuːɪŋ mˈɔː wˈɜːk ðɐn ðɪ ˈaktʃuːəl ˈɪnfɹəstɹˌʌktʃə/

lines.speaker: A
lines.text: Exactly. Less confident riders still have to get off and find another crossing.
lines.ipa: /ɛɡzˈaktli lˈɛs kˈɒnfɪdənt ɹˈaɪdəz stˈɪl hav tə ɡɛt ˈɒf and fˈaɪnd ɐnˈʌðə kɹˈɒsɪŋ/

lines.speaker: B
lines.text: Test the journey with them before describing the route as continuous.
lines.ipa: /tˈɛst ðə dʒˈɜːni wɪð ðˌɛm bɪfˌɔː dɪskɹˈaɪbɪŋ ðə ɹˈuːt az kəntˈɪnjuːəs/

lines.speaker: A
lines.text: The consultation attracted hundreds of responses, mostly after a widely shared post.
lines.ipa: /ðə kɒnsəltˈeɪʃən ɐtɹˈaktɪd hˈʌndɹɪdz ɒv ɹɪspˈɒnsɪz mˈəʊstli ˈaftəɹ ɐ wˈaɪdli ʃˈeəd pˈəʊst/

lines.speaker: B
lines.text: Does the summary acknowledge where those responses came from?
lines.ipa: /dˈʌz ðə sˈʌməɹi ɐknˈɒlɪdʒ wˌeə ðəʊz ɹɪspˈɒnsɪz kˈeɪm fɹɒm/

lines.speaker: A
lines.text: It presents the total as though it were a balanced sample.
lines.ipa: /ɪt pɹɪzˈɛnts ðə tˈəʊtəl az ðˌəʊ ɪt wɜːɹ ɐ bˈalənst sˈampəl/

lines.speaker: B
lines.text: Volume matters, but it doesn't by itself tell you whose views remain unheard.
lines.ipa: /vˈɒljuːm mˈatəz bˌʌt ɪt dˈʌzənt baɪ ɪtsˈɛlf tˈɛl juː hˌuːz vjˈuːz ɹɪmˈeɪn ʌnhˈɜːd/

lines.speaker: A
lines.text: The community budget meeting was open to everyone, provided they could attend at three on a weekday.
lines.ipa: /ðə kəmjˈuːnɪti bˈʌdʒɪt mˈiːtɪŋ wɒz ˈəʊpən tʊ ˈɛvɹɪwˌɒn pɹəvˈaɪdɪd ðeɪ kʊd ɐtˈɛnd at θɹˈiː ˌɒn ɐ wˈiːkdeɪ/

lines.speaker: B
lines.text: That's a fairly consequential qualification.
lines.ipa: /ðats ɐ fˈeəli kˌɒnsɪkwˈɛnʃəl kwˌɒlɪfɪkˈeɪʃən/

lines.speaker: A
lines.text: The organisers were surprised that parents and shift workers didn't contribute.
lines.ipa: /ðɪ ˈɔːɡɐnˌaɪzəz wɜː səpɹˈaɪzd ðat pˈeəɹənts and ʃˈɪft wˈɜːkəz dˈɪdnt kəntɹˈɪbjuːt/

lines.speaker: B
lines.text: Offer another route to participation before interpreting absence as lack of interest.
lines.ipa: /ˈɒfəɹ ɐnˈʌðə ɹˈuːt tə pɑːtˈɪsɪpˈeɪʃən bɪfˌɔːɹ ɪntˈɜːpɹɪtɪŋ ˈabsəns az lˈak ɒv ˈɪntɹɛst/
